Email Design Lead

Remote. Full-time. South America. Paid in USD.

Performance retention agency for 9-figure DTC brands. Email and SMS are the product. Design is not decoration on top of it. Campaigns have to look like the brand and still convert. The book spans fashion editorial, clean beauty, loud CPG, and luxury accessories. One house style will not work here.

We are hiring the person who owns email design quality across the agency, and we are hiring in South America because the work runs on US hours and the talent here is better than the market pays for.

This is a player-coach seat. You set the first designs for every new client yourself. You build the visual system they will live in: type, photography treatment, merchandising, campaign worlds. Then you lead the graphic designers who execute against that system, and you hold the bar on everything that leaves the agency.

If you have only ever executed someone else's art direction, or only designed for one brand in-house, this is not the role.

What you'll own

  • The first emails for every new client. You design them. You do not brief them out and hope.
  • The visual system for each brand: type, photography (crop, cutout, collage), color, merchandising, motion if it earns its place.
  • Design quality across the whole book of business. If a campaign looks like a Klaviyo template, a restyled module, or a social graphic dumped into an email, that is on you.
  • The graphic designers. Brief them, critique the work, raise the floor, and keep them shipping at the standard you set.
  • Campaign-level art direction for weekly sends, promos, and drops. Each drop should feel like a designed world, not a product grid with a new header.
  • Partnership with strategists and copywriters. You take a brief and make it look expensive. You push back when the brief will produce generic work.
  • Taste across categories. A fashion drop and a clean beauty campaign should not share a layout.

Language

Agency works in English. You will run critique, take briefs, and sit on client calls in English every day. Written English is not enough on its own. If you would not be comfortable pushing back on a US strategist in a live call, this is the wrong seat and we would both find that out in week two.

Hours

You hold 9am to 5pm EST every working day. The rest of your day is yours to shape. São Paulo, Buenos Aires, Montevideo and Santiago are EST plus 1 or 2. Lima and Quito are EST. If you are not willing to protect that window, do not apply.

Requirements

      • You have worked at an agency that services 8-9-figure ecommerce / DTC brands. Name the agency and the brands. "Worked with" logos you never designed for do not count.
      • An exceptional email book. Campaign art direction, not flow production. Custom display type, photography that is treated, merchandising that still looks designed. If the book is catalog, sale, and default type, do not apply.
      • You still design. This is not a Creative Director seat for someone who only critiques. The first work on a new client is yours.
      • You have led designers before. Small team is fine. You know how to brief, redline, and get better work out of other people without sanding it down to safe.
      • Mastery of Figma. Adobe is assumed. You can build for Klaviyo without designing like Klaviyo.
      • Range. Fashion, beauty, CPG, accessories. One aesthetic is a specialist. We need a lead.
      • Fluent professional English, spoken and written. This is a hard requirement, not a preference.
      • Based in Brazil, Argentina, Uruguay, Chile, Peru or Ecuador, and able to work 9am to 1pm EST.
    • Send a portfolio link with your application. Applications without a book that shows email work go straight to the bottom of the pile. If your email work is under NDA, send the closest editorial or campaign work you can share and say so.

Performance Bonuses

Our mission is to help individuals and families build strong foundations for healthy, fulfilling lives.

Assist in the development and implementation of standard operating procedures (SOPs) and documentation for reporting needs and user training.

jobs.description:
The Federal Budget Coordinator / Cost Analyst is responsible for overseeing planning, execution, monitoring, and reporting of budgets and costs for federally funded programs and contracts. This role ensures financial integrity, regulatory compliance, and accurate cost accounting in accordance with federal regulations, contract requirements, and generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP). The position serves as a key liaison between USPS leadership, finance, and external stakeholders to support sound fiscal management and audit readiness.

Key Responsibilities

Federal Budget Coordination

  • Develop, manage, and monitor program and contract budgets across multiple funding sources and fiscal years.

  • Track obligations, expenditures, burn rates, and forecasts to ensure alignment with approved funding levels and contract terms.

  • Prepare budget justifications, estimates at completion (EACs), and variance analyses; identify risks and recommend corrective actions.

  • Support budget modifications, re-baseline efforts, and funding realignments in coordination with program and contracting staff.

Cost Accounting & Financial Controls

  • Apply cost accounting principles to ensure accurate allocation, allowability, and documentation of direct and indirect costs.

  • Review and reconcile labor, subcontractor, vendor, and other direct charges against approved budgets and cost structures.

  • Maintain audit-ready financial records, including supporting documentation for invoices, accruals, and cost transfers.

  • Support monthly close activities, reconciliations, and financial reporting in coordination with corporate finance teams.

  • Assist with internal and external audits, monitoring reviews, and responses to findings or data requests.

Reporting & Stakeholder Support

  • Prepare and deliver routine and ad hoc financial reports for program leadership, corporate finance, and government clients.

  • Serve as a financial advisor to project managers, providing guidance on budgeting, cost controls, and financial decision-making.

  • Contribute to the development and improvement of financial policies, procedures, templates, and tracking tools.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree

  • Minimum of 3 years of experience with financial analysis related to IT programs

  • US Citizenship required by federal contract

Additional Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience supporting budgets and cost accounting for federal contracts or federally funded programs.

  • Working knowledge of GAAP and federal financial compliance requirements.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret financial data and communicate results clearly.

Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT:

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for:

  • 5+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard:
Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

Requirements and benefits

Educational qualifications

  • A Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science / Data Analytics, Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning, Computational Linguistics / Natural Language Processing (NLP), Information Systems or other related fields.
  • Bachelor’s degree is accepted if only candidate has 5 years of experience in the field.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a minimum of 3 years of professional experience in related roles or domain - specifically for QA-automation/testing or cybersecurity roles

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Compensation:
Paid per accepted task. Your rate depends on the qualification tier you reach and how efficiently you complete tasks — up to the equivalent of $30/hr. Because payment is per task, a faster pace raises your effective hourly rate.

Experience

  • Solid experience in operations management, general management, logistics, or inventory management — ideally including international logistics/import-export exposure.
  • A background that spans a variety of roles, with demonstrated ability to step up into a broad, senior generalist position.

  • Direct experience managing international incoming stock, product, and freight — including ownership of timelines from origin through to delivery.
  • Experience with local demand profiling and stock forecasting, with the ability to plan and manage the gap between manufacture time and actual arrival of stock, often spanning several months.

Technical & Software Skills

Critical

  • Number one priority: genuine, hands-on ability to integrate AI into everyday operations — building automations and workflow integrations (e.g. with Gemini and Claude), and continuously adapting these as new models, tools, and methods become available, to keep making processes more efficient and productive.
  • Fluency in Google Workspace.

  • Comfortable and confident on the phone — proactively calling suppliers, factories, logistics providers, and partners rather than waiting on email replies.

  • Highly proactive self-starter — the founders should never need to chase this person for updates or progress.
  • Comfortable operating with autonomy and taking ownership of outcomes, while keeping stakeholders proactively informed.

Raising a better idea with us is always welcome, never a problem.

We're comfortable with AI ourselves, but we're looking for this role to be excellent at it — someone we can genuinely learn from and lean on as the AI expert in the business.

Role Overview: We are looking for a highly proactive, senior-level Operations Manager / General Manager to be the operational glue that holds our business together. Team Leadership & Delegation

AI, Systems & Automation

  • Own AI integration across the business as a core part of the role — applying advanced, hands-on experience with AI tools beyond basic chat use, including building automations, integrations, and connectors (e.g. with Claude and Gemini) to streamline reporting and operational workflows.

Customer Service

  • Oversee our customer service team member's performance, with regular spot-checks of the inbox to keep a genuine pulse on customer satisfaction and emerging issues — not simply relying on reported summaries.

Documentation & Process

Marketing & Stakeholder Coordination

  • Attend marketing team meetings and translate marketing activity (promotions, campaigns, content pushes) into operational impact — e.g. anticipated changes in demand, customer engagement, or inventory needs.

  • Set and run meetings with suppliers, 3PLs, consultants, and other stakeholders — owning the communication end-to-end.

eCommerce Platform & Site Management

Retail, Wholesale & Partnerships Outreach

Data & Commercial Ownership

  • Comfortable analysing performance metrics and KPIs and turning them into clear, actionable recommendations — not just reporting numbers back.
  • Working budget/P&L literacy — able to forecast and manage spend within their area, even without owning the full P&L.
  • Run regular inventory audits in partnership with the warehouse/3PL, and manage inventory reporting and invoicing.
  • Awareness of cash flow and working capital — understanding how inventory timing, order volume, and payment terms affect the cash tied up in the business, and flagging when something looks off.
  • Basic awareness of currency/FX exposure — understanding how exchange rate movements affect landed cost and margin on internationally sourced stock.
  • Enough commercial awareness of pricing to flag when a promotion, discount, or bundle risks eroding margin — without owning pricing strategy itself.

Vendor & Tech Stack Management

  • Manage vendor relationships and third-party platform integrations across our tech stack.
  • General marketing literacy — a solid enough understanding of how marketing campaigns and channels work to hold our external marketing agency accountable and translate their activity into operational impact.
  • Work alongside the founders to measure consultant/agency performance against agreed KPIs, and take part in running regular consultant performance reviews.

Commercial Awareness & Team Building

  • Stay outward-looking — aware of industry trends and competitor activity, not just internally focused on our own operations.
  • As the team grows, build and mentor team members rather than just managing tasks.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Customer service inbox fully actioned by the end of each business day — whether handled directly or in conjunction with the customer service rep they manage.

Growth Path

This is a fixed role at a senior, lead-manager level from day one. As the business scales, this person will be given increasing resources, direct reports, and autonomy to delegate across a growing team.

  • Experience forecasting load and generation growth

  • Familiarity with short circuit software including ASPEN, CAPE, or ETAP

  • Familiarity of utility protection philosophy and short circuit studies

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills including technical report writing

jobs.description:
Business and Legal Affairs, Associate

Symphonic is a fully independent music technology, distribution, and marketing company based in Tampa, Florida, with a global team and presence in New York City, Nashville, and major music markets worldwide, supporting independent artists and labels internationally.

We’re passionate about music, but even more passionate about the people behind it. We’re looking for curious, driven, and collaborative individuals who want to build, learn, and grow with us. We believe diverse perspectives make better teams, better products, and better outcomes, and we’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone belongs. The Business and Legal Affairs Associate will work remotely, reporting to the Director of Business and Legal Affairs, who is based in Charlotte, North Carolina, and leads our Legal Team.

In a Nutshell //

Symphonic Distribution is seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Business and Legal Affairs Associate to support our growing Legal Team, reporting to and working directly with the Director of Business and Legal Affairs. This role focuses on creating and maintaining contract frameworks across a range of agreement types, with particular emphasis on custom client deals, digital distribution agreements, and other related contracts. The ideal candidate has strong organizational and communication skills and the ability to manage multiple ongoing projects with sound judgment and limited oversight. This is an opportunity to contribute meaningfully to empowering artists, labels, and managers with the tools and expertise they need to thrive in today's music industry.

What you will do //

  • Draft and update contract frameworks and templates for digital distribution agreements, licensing arrangements, and other custom client and partner deals.
  • Review, redline, and help negotiate digital distribution agreements, addenda, and custom client and partner deals, escalating novel or high-risk issues to the Director.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to understand business needs and incorporate them into contractual terms.
  • Maintain and manage legal workflows and contract lifecycle updates via project management tools (primarily Monday.com or other applications as requested).
  • Track the status of contract projects and provide timely updates to the Director of Business and Legal Affairs and relevant teams.
  • Conduct entity verification and KYC/KYB diligence across U.S. and international registries, sanctions/PEP screening, and identity verification, and summarize findings for internal stakeholders.
  • Assist Legal and Finance with deal diligence, including vetting the contracting party, client rightsholdership, client history, account information, and other data necessary for advising internal stakeholders and drafting accurate contracts.
  • Support general legal and operational initiatives, including research, internal documentation, and compliance projects.
  • Help ensure consistency in legal language and formatting across documents.
  • Maintain organized and up-to-date records of contract templates, revisions, and executed documents.
  • Research and analyze trends and emerging law and industry practices related to operations, contracting, copyright, improper activity, and other legal matters.
  • Communicate and liaise with internal stakeholders concerning legal policies, processes, and procedures.
  • Provide support on escalated legal matters.
  • Brief the Director of Business and Legal Affairs regularly and consistently on the status of contracting activities.
  • Complete other projects as identified by the Business and Legal Affairs Team.

What you need to have //

  • Bachelor's degree required; J.D., paralegal certificate, or equivalent legal training strongly preferred.
  • J.D. with meaningful business and legal affairs internship or work experience, OR three to five years of post-graduate experience in a B&LA, contracts, or transactional environment. Music, entertainment, or technology background preferred but not required.
  • Proficiency with contract/project management platforms (e.g., Monday.com, Dropbox, Google Workspace, HubSpot).
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Strong time management skills with the ability to handle multiple tasks and meet tight deadlines.
  • Self-motivation with a strong sense of initiative.
  • High energy, high-volume, detail-oriented work style with the drive to own your workload and grow fast.
  • Coachable and confident, with the ability to take ownership of projects, receive feedback, and iterate quickly.
  • Excitement to keep learning and to become a go-to for knowledge and resources.
  • Ability to fully engage and integrate with the team while working remotely.
  • High standard of ethics and the ability to maintain confidential information.

What would set you apart //

  • Fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese is not necessary but would be super helpful!
  • Familiarity with music licensing, intellectual property, and digital distribution.
  • Passion for contracting, IP rights and licensing, copyright law, and related topics such as AI issues and regulation.
  • Keen interest in the legal aspects of the independent distribution and music space.

What would be the icing on the cake //

  • At least one year of experience drafting distribution agreements and other music licensing contracts.
  • Experience collaborating with Deal, Sales, and Finance Teams.
  • A can-do attitude and willingness to tackle matters outside the core area of expertise.

Additional Insights //

  • This position reports to the Director of Business and Legal Affairs, who leads our Legal Team. The role is designed to grow: the right candidate will handle first-pass agreements, redlines, contract intake, and diligence within the first few months, with a path toward increasingly independent drafting and negotiation as the Legal function scales..
  • This position is remote, with an expectation that the candidate will remain a resident in the location of hire.
  • Minimal travel may be required.
  • Candidates must be current residents of Philadelphia, PA.

About Symphonic //

Symphonic Distribution enables content creators to fully maximize their music’s revenue and grow their global audience. The company focuses on working with: record labels, artists, managers, producers, social media influencers, and even distributors just like us to get their messages seen and heard. While our core business is to distribute music digitally and physically for the many talented creators that we have the honor of working with, we focus on a number of services, such as: Physical Distribution, User Generated Content Monetization on YouTube, Tik Tok, Triller, Instagram, Release Promotion such as Playlist pitching, marketing diagnostics, strategy and a number of other very important services to ensure that creators are maximizing and collecting on as many royalties as possible. Symphonic also showcases one of the largest partnership networks available, partnering with Spotify, Apple Music, Pandora, Amazon, and many other services where music can be consumed on. Check out more about us on our website at www.symphonic.com.

Salary: Salary Range $75,000.00 to $95,000.00 Yearly

About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

This position sits within Nebius Token Factory, our serverless platform for running and customizing open-source LLMs in production. Token Factory allows for serverless inference and fine-tuning backed by in-house optimizations like custom speculative decoding, quantization, cache-aware routing and dedicated endpoints. Customers come to us to move from prototype to scaled production without the cost and complexity of building and tuning their own inference stack.

Our Solutions Architects own the technical delivery of customer engagements: deploying open-source models, tuning the serving stack, benchmarking against the customer's success criteria, and carrying the technical relationship through to production. Sales Engineers qualify and scope the opportunity; SAs execute it. Technical Account Managers take it from production onward.

We're looking for a Manager, ML Solutions Architecture to lead our US regional SA teams. Your scope is PoC delivery and post-sales technical support: the people who do it, the standard they do it to, and the operating cadence that keeps it predictable. You will report to the Head of Solutions Architecture and partner with a peer manager in the other region.

We expect you to push people when they need pushing, make the uncomfortable call when deliverables don't land even though the effort was real, and take ownership of the documentation work: implement and monitor the following of the guidelines, ticket hygiene, and making sure the team actually uses all three.

You're welcome to work remotely from the United States.

Your responsibilities will include:

Lead the team

  • Manage a team of 4 Solutions Architects, with continued growth planned: 1:1s, goal setting, performance reviews, promotion cases, and individual growth plans
  • Build an accurate picture of each SA's strengths, gaps, and preferences, and allocate accounts and engagements against both expertise and interest
  • Run the cadence that surfaces blockers early, then take them to the development, product, and business teams that can clear them, and stay on them until they do
  • Hold people to outcomes: distinguish effort from delivered results, say so plainly when the two diverge, and reflect it in ratings and compensation decisions
  • Onboard new joiners through to their first independently delivered engagement
  • Coach SAs into stronger engineers and stronger communicators, and make deliberate calls about who is ready for more scope

Own delivery

  • Be accountable for your team's delivery outcomes: time from PoC kick-off to first optimized dedicated endpoint, success-criteria hit rate, and the quality of the technical relationship after the customer goes to production
  • Review technical work before it reaches the customer: benchmarking methodology, serving configurations, results, closure documents; catch the wrong conclusion drawn from a metrics artifact before a customer sees it
  • Ensure staffing and escalation coverage across accounts and timezones, including post-sales request load that does not respect sprint boundaries
  • Call infeasibility early and with evidence, rather than letting the team burn iterations against requirements the platform cannot meet today

Own the operating system of the team

  • Maintain and extend the team's documentation: responsibilities, runbooks, guides, onboarding, definitions of done, engagement closure templates. Keep it accurate and reachable; link, don't copy
  • Get it used, not just written: documentation nobody reads is a cost, not an asset
  • Keep the ticket tracker the system of record, so PoC and production status is readable without asking anyone
  • Instrument the work: define and report the metrics that show whether delivery is getting faster and more reliable over time

Work across teams

  • Development and research teams: convert recurring customer pain into prioritized platform work, and represent the customer's technical reality in roadmap discussions
  • Pre-sales: hold the scoping-to-execution boundary: push back on under-scoped engagements, and feed feasibility signal back upstream
  • Account management: make production handoffs uneventful, and keep post-sales technical requests moving
  • Business and leadership: give a straight read on account health, technical feasibility, and capacity needs

We expect you to have:

  • 3+ years managing technical teams, including performance management and difficult conversations
  • Experience managing a customer-facing team. Running a team whose work is visible to customers, on customer timelines, with customer escalations.
  • Strong ML knowledge: LLM architectures, fine-tuning approaches (SFT/LoRA, RL-based), evaluation design, and a working command of inference internals — quantization, KV-cache management, batching, routing, speculative decoding — and of the frameworks the team works in (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM)
  • Enough technical judgment to review someone else's benchmark and find the flaw in the methodology, not just in the conclusion
  • Python strong enough to read and review your team's code
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain technical concepts to diverse audiences, from engineers to executives, including in front of enterprise customers under pressure
  • Genuine tolerance for operational work: documentation, process design, reporting, and the follow-through that makes them stick
  • Comfort operating with ambiguity across distributed teams and timezones, and a bias toward writing things down

It would be an added bonus if you have:

  • Experience scaling a team through rapid growth (5 → 15+) without losing delivery quality
  • Prior experience in a customer-facing technical function at a cloud, inference, or AI infrastructure provider
  • Experience defining process and documentation for a team that had none
  • Hands-on background running LLMs in production and debugging inference workloads at the framework level
  • Work with multimodal AI models (vision-language, speech)
  • Proficiency with DevOps tooling (Docker, Kubernetes) and infrastructure-as-code

Preferred technical stack:

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT:

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for:

  • 5+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard:
Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

Requirements and benefits

Educational qualifications

We are looking for a Head of Delivery to own the operational backbone of how Offshorly delivers work across a portfolio of global clients: quality standards, playbooks, team optimization, and mentoring across Project Managers and delivery teams. This is the person who defines what excellent delivery means at Offshorly and builds the systems and tool kit that make it repeatable. You'll also be the escalation point after Project Managers when delivery issues need to go further, solving problems fast and representing Offshorly with professionalism.

This is both a strategic and tactical role. You'll have real input into how the delivery model evolves as CAST matures. We're results-oriented here, so you'll have real autonomy in how you run delivery, not oversight for its own sake.

Ideal for someone who loves bringing structure, solving delivery blockers, and keeping people moving forward.

Client account ownership is a secondary, not primary, expectation for this role. Where a candidate can also carry account management and client success responsibilities, that is a genuine bonus. Where they cannot, the General Manager will cover that ground directly.

Operational Excellence and Team OKRs (Primary):

  • Own delivery quality and standards across all client projects and CAST units, including leading onboarding for new clients so expectations and success metrics are aligned from day one.

  • Coordinate with delivery teams to keep resources aligned across client projects and business goals; track timelines and blockers and escalate risk to leadership when needed.

  • Set and track business OKRs tied to delivery, productivity, and quality from which team OKRs build on.

  • Mentor Project Managers and Team Leads, including performance reviews.

  • Build and evolve delivery playbooks so AI orchestration stays consistent as CAST progressively rolls out across delivery teams.

  • Contribute to shaping delivery strategy as CAST matures, including client reporting and capacity forecasting for delivery pipelines.

  • Partner with AI Team leadership on how playbook and orchestration rollout affects delivery standards, without owning AI Excellence reporting or team oversight directly (that sits elsewhere).

Account Management and Client Success (Secondary, bonus if covered):

  • Internal alignment with PMs to stay across delivery status and client needs.

  • External client management touchpoints (monthly and/or quarterly).

  • Build working relationships with clients, partnering with leadership on the bigger picture.

What You'll Own:

Day-to-Day Delivery:

Documentation and Planning:

  • Playbook documentation: create, maintain, and version delivery playbooks and case studies, with support from PMs, as the operating model evolves.

  • Calm under pressure, proactive in finding solutions.

  • Bonus: experience with AI-native or AI-augmented delivery models.

  • Bonus: account management or client-facing experience (this is not required, but genuinely valued).

What You'll Get:

  • Ownership of how Offshorly delivers, at a moment where that model is actively being redefined.

  • A genuine voice in shaping delivery strategy as the business evolves.

  • Real autonomy to run delivery your way, we care about outcomes.

  • A people-first culture that values growth, ownership, and contribution.

  • Structured career support and advanced AI training.

  • Bonuses and very competitive salary.

  • Direct partnership with the executive leadership team on the next chapter of the business.

Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end-to-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.

Location

This is a remote position. You can work from home and be located anywhere in the US

About the team

The Application Solution Architect is a senior role within Kinaxis’s Professional Services, Innovation and Data Science Services team. You will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams across Product, R&D, Data Services, and Professional Services to deliver end-to-end customer projects for Enterprise Scheduling and other advanced planning capabilities.

In this role, you will help customers solve complex supply chain challenges by designing scalable, high-quality solution architectures. This role requires deep supply chain domain expertise, including a strong understanding of how supply planning and detailed scheduling interact across the broader supply chain landscape. The architect must ensure these processes are designed cohesively so planning logic, material feasibility, capacity assumptions, and shop-floor scheduling work together seamlessly to support feasible and efficient operational execution.

What you will do

  • Define and own the ES solution architecture—including functional design, data structures, constraint models, integrations, and system behavior—working in close partnership with the Solution Architect, where present, to ensure alignment with the overall end‑to‑end solution architecture. In ES‑only implementations, serve as the primary solution architect for the engagement.
  • Facilitate detailed scheduling blueprint sessions that translate manufacturing requirements into scalable configurations, defining heuristics, dispatch rules, look-ahead behavior, changeover logic, and constraint-resolution strategies for complex production environments.
  • Identify risks throughout the project lifecycle and develop mitigation strategies to ensure successful deployments.
  • Troubleshoot complex scheduling behavior and resolve data configuration issues, providing root-cause analysis and recommending appropriate configuration patterns.
  • Provide functional leadership and help to solve complex supply chain challenges and implementation support
  • Provide mentorship and technical oversight to consultants and partners on solution quality, scheduling implementation methods, repeatable architecture patterns, and deployment best practices, while overseeing delegation of configuration tasks.
  • Collaborate with Product teams on feature gaps, capability extensions, and areas requiring architectural guidance while influencing roadmap discussions through customer insights and solution best practices.
  • Support services sales opportunities by articulating solution approaches and value to stakeholders.

What we are looking for

  • Bachelor's or master's degree in industrial engineering, Supply Chain, Operations Research, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Statistics, Information Technology or related field.
  • Minimum 8 years of broad experience in software implementation consulting in the supply chain planning or supply chain execution space, including 3+ years as a solution architect or lead functional consultant for enterprise-scale supply chain transformation projects.
  • Excellent facilitation and communication skills; able to guide customer discussions across planners, schedulers, project teams, and stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to work in fast-paced, matrixed environments with strong initiative and leadership capabilities.
  • Advanced problem-solving and critical thinking skills with the ability to synthesize complex information and guide teams toward deploying high-quality solutions that align with the intended architectural design.
  • Proven interpersonal, leadership, and mentoring skills within cross-functional teams.

Role Specific Skills and experience

  • Subject matter expert in supply chain concepts and best practices coupled with in-depth experience with supply chain solutions and scheduling applications (such as OMP, SAP PPDS, Blue Yonder, or o9 Production Scheduling).
  • Experience producing detailed blueprints that translate scheduling requirements into technical specifications during software implementations.
  • Technical leadership experience in data integration, data management, system configuration and system deployment for supply chain software implementations.
  • Proficiency with SQL, JavaScript, or scripting languages used in solution configuration.

Are you an Occupational Therapist looking for an opportunity to apply your professional skills in a different way?

We welcome applications from Occupational Therapists working across physical health, mental health, community, rehabilitation and social care settings, as well as newly qualified Occupational Therapists looking to develop specialist skills in vocational rehabilitation and employment support.

We're looking for an Occupational Therapist (Employment & Wellbeing) to join our specialist team. This is an exciting opportunity to work within an innovative vocational rehabilitation model, helping people overcome health-related barriers and move towards improved wellbeing, independence and sustainable employment

Working as part of a multidisciplinary team, you'll support participants whose health, disability, neurodiversity or wellbeing barriers impact their ability to gain, retain or progress in employment. Focusing on functional ability rather than diagnosis alone, you'll undertake assessments, develop practical interventions, recommend adjustments and create personalised plans that support long term employment outcomes.

You'll work closely with Employment Advisors, Wellbeing Specialists and employers to help participants build confidence, manage barriers and prepare for sustainable work.

This role provides an opportunity to combine occupational therapy practice with meaningful social impact, helping people overcome barriers to employment whilst developing specialist skills in vocational rehabilitation, workplace health and supported employment.

Structured support, supervision and professional development will be provided, helping you develop your skills and confidence within an innovative employment and wellbeing service.

jobs.excerpt: Job Description We Move Fast, Think on Our Feet, and Have Fun Doing It!
jobs.description:
Job Description

We Move Fast, Think on Our Feet, and Have Fun Doing It!

At Eleven, we thrive on solving complex challenges and pushing boundaries. We work at a rapid pace, embracing change, and staying laser-focused on delivering exceptional value to our customers.

We’re looking for visionary problem-solvers who excel in dynamic environments, embrace AI tools in streamlining work processes, adapt quickly, and drive innovation. If you love thinking outside the box, collaborating with top-tier talent, and having fun while making an impact—let’s talk!

POSITION PURPOSE

We are seeking a highly skilled and analytical Senior Quality Assurance Engineer to lead the quality assurance efforts for our core software applications. You will design, build, and execute robust automated and manual testing strategies that validate end-to-end functionality, high-throughput network authentication, API integrations, and data pipeline integrity.

An ideal candidate is not a traditional black-box tester; you are a technical gatekeeper who understands underlying infrastructures, can query complex relational databases, and is comfortable leveraging AI tools to accelerate test coverage.

REPORTING RELATIONSHIPS

This role will report to the CTO and has no direct reports. 

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

    • Automation Framework Design: Design, implement, and maintain advanced test automation frameworks for backend systems, network integrations, and multi-layered web applications.
    • API Validation: Lead end-to-end testing of RESTful APIs, third-party API integrations, and secure network communication workflows.
    • Cloud Infrastructure Verification: Ensure cloud architectures deployed on AWS run flawlessly by testing deployments utilizing EC2, Lambda serverless environments, S3 storage, and DynamoDB tables. Ensure strict adherence to AWS IAM policies and security groups.
    • Data & Analytics Testing: Formulate and execute rigorous T-SQL scripts to validate relational database schemas and data mutations. Manage and test search/indexing layers built on OpenSearch.
    • Modern Tooling Integration: Incorporate and scale generative AI technologies into the testing workflow to auto-generate mock data, synthesize edge-case scenarios, and optimize boilerplate test script writing.
    • Defect Lifecycle Leadership: Identify, document, isolate, and track bugs through Jira/Azure DevOps, providing deep technical insights (logs, network traces, stack traces) to accelerate developer remediation.

WORKING CONDITIONS

This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, and printers. This job operates remotely, in a home office environment. Travel requirements are minimal for this role.  

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs; talk or hear. The employee must occasionally lift or move office products and supplies, up to 20 pounds. The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.  

REQUIREMENTS

Must Have:

    • Experience: 8 + years of professional software QA engineering experience, with a heavy emphasis on test automation and backend validation.
    • Programming Skills: Strong proficiency in C# and the .NET ecosystem, alongside experience writing, testing, and debugging PHP backend code.
    • AWS Cloud Proficiency: Hands-on experience testing workloads deployed on core AWS architecture, specifically EC2 instances, AWS Lambda functions, S3, DynamoDB, and managing security parameters through AWS IAM.
    • Databases & Search Engines: High proficiency with relational database systems using T-SQL (writing queries, stored procedures, joins) and validating telemetry or index structures inside OpenSearch/Elasticsearch.
    • API Testing Expertise: Advanced mastery of RESTful API contracts, using tools like Postman, SoapUI, or automated HTTP clients.

Strongly Preferred:

    • AI-Powered Test Automation: Hands-on experience with AI-assisted testing tools and frameworks (e.g., Playwright with AI-driven locators/self-healing selectors, Xray for intelligent test management and traceability) to reduce test maintenance overhead and flaky test rates.
    • LLM-Assisted QA Workflows: Experience using LLMs (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.) for test case generation, log analysis, root-cause triage, or synthetic test data creation.
    • AI Tooling Adoption: Active experience utilizing advanced AI technologies (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude API integrations) to speed up test execution or build intelligent mock services.
    • CI/CD Expertise: Proven track record of baking automated suites directly into continuous integration and deployment pipelines.
    • Bachelor's degree in related field

Candidates for this role, must be based in the United States and legally eligible to work for any US employer. Eleven is not able to sponsor candidates at this time. This role will be open for applications August 18, 2026 through September 30, 2026.

Eleven is a remote work employer and offers a comprehensive compensation and benefits package. Our benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage; a 401(k) plan; and an attractive paid time off policy with no fixed number of vacation days — take what you need, when you need it. Balanced Time Off (BTO) does not accrue and is not paid out upon separation. Employees also receive 11 paid holidays, and Eleven closes for a company-wide end-of-year holiday break that all employees enjoy together — check with your People team for specific dates each year.

The base salary range for this job in all geographic locations in the United States is $120,000 to $130,000 USD. Individual salaries within those ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills, and geography.

Harbor IT is backed by investment firm Worklyn Partners since 2022 and has built a national platform through acquisition and rapid organic growth. Our mission is to manage our clients’ technology and mitigate their cyber risks, so that they don’t have to.

Position Overview:

The Help Desk Technician II is a remote-first support role within Harbor IT’s Service Delivery organization, serving as a primary escalation point for complex support tickets across healthcare, medical, and life sciences clients. This role owns tickets end-to-end, from intake and triage through resolution and documentation, and provides technical mentorship to Help Desk I technicians. The Help Desk Technician II works across a diverse mix of client environments to maintain operational stability and deliver high-quality service that reflects Harbor IT’s customer service standard. In environments where uptime, data security, and regulatory sensitivity (HIPAA, PHI handling, clinical and lab operations) carry real operational weight, this role demands precision and professionalism. This role requires a growth and development mindset to keep up with the rapidly evolving technology landscape. The Help Desk Technician II approaches troubleshooting with methodical and logical critical thinking. This is a key role in Harbor IT’s Managed Services practice, reporting to the Pod Manager and is a primary developmental pipeline into other Service Delivery career tracks.

Key Responsibilities:

·Serve as the Tier 2 escalation point for Help Desk I technicians, resolving advanced hardware, software, and network issues that exceed first-tier resolution capability.

·Administer and troubleshoot Microsoft 365 (Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive), Entra ID, Active Directory, and Intune-managed endpoints — including GPO management and security configurations.

·Troubleshoot Windows 10/11 OS issues including user profile corruption, printer and network connectivity failures, and MFA-related problems.

·Apply foundational security practices including MFA/Conditional Access administration, endpoint protection (EDR) monitoring and response, and awareness of HIPAA/PHI handling requirements specific to healthcare and life sciences environments.

·Collaborate with infrastructure and project teams to assist with client deployments, migrations, and server upgrades.

·Perform proactive system monitoring and maintenance to ensure uptime and performance across the client portfolio.

·Create and maintain accurate internal and client-facing documentation, including knowledge base articles, network diagrams, asset inventories, and standard operating procedures.

·Identify recurring issues, inefficiencies, or improvement opportunities in the client environment and escalate or propose solutions through the Pod Manager and Account Team (CSM and CIO).

·Mentor and guide Help Desk I technicians through ticket resolution, knowledge transfer, and professional development feedback.

·Participate in emergency on-call rotation, responding to after-hours incidents, outages, and critical client escalations as scheduled.

·Engage in team knowledge-sharing, training, and process-improvement initiatives

Qualifications & Skills:

·Working experience across the Microsoft 365 and Azure platform (setup, configuration, troubleshooting) including Office, Exchange, Teams, SharePoint/OneDrive, and Entra ID.

·Experience with Active Directory administration including GPOs, user/group management, and hybrid identity configurations.

·Demonstrated proficiency with ticket triage, prioritization, and root cause analysis in an MSP or professional services environment.

·Familiarity with modern endpoint and mail security tooling: EDR/antivirus/mail filtering platforms (e.g., SentinelOne, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Proofpoint, Mimecast, Barracuda), MFA and identity platforms (e.g., Duo, Okta, Entra ID).

·Conceptual understanding of networking fundamentals: firewalls, switching, DNS/DHCP, and wireless (exposure to Meraki, Fortinet, or Palo Alto a plus).

·Basic familiarity with backup and storage technologies (e.g., Veeam, Cove, Datto, cloud backup platforms).

·Confidence with basic AI concepts and use cases, with an emphasis on security and data and IP governance.

·Comfort working in healthcare-adjacent environments with sensitivity to HIPAA, PHI handling, and clinical/lab operational constraints.

·Strong troubleshooting, logic, and critical thinking skills.

·Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate technical issues into plain language for non-technical clinical and administrative staff.

·Self-motivated with strong time management and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment.

·Ability to identify and articulate opportunities for improvement within a client’s environment.

·Demonstrated ability to mentor and develop junior technicians.

·Focus on continuous professional development in the technology industry and willingness to achieve technical certifications required to support our client and partnership needs.

Position Summary:

Job Description:

Position: Western Colorado University invites applications for the full-time, remote position of Online Professional Studies Program Assistant and Academic Advisor. The position reports to the Director of Online Professional Studies, works closely with the Online Professional Studies team, and is responsible for providing administrative and operational support to the Online Professional Studies department as well as providing academic advising and enrollment support for new and continuing students in the Adult Degree Completion and Western Flexible Learning programs.

Responsibilities: The Program Assistant and Academic Advisor is responsible for coordinating course scheduling and supporting faculty communication, including creating and updating course schedules, payment to faculty, syllabi tracking and faculty support. They also assist with purchasing and budget tracking, including processing invoices and reconciling expenses in accordance with university procedures. This position supports scholarship processes by tracking awards, maintaining records, and coordinating communication with students and the Foundation. They also organize and execute program events (e.g., graduation), including logistics, communication, and day-of coordination. This position maintains and updates program materials and digital content, including website updates and social media and provides general administrative support such as meeting scheduling, note-taking, data tracking, and maintaining accurate student and program records in university systems.

In addition, this position will provide individualized academic advising support for approximately 75-120 students, helping to interpret degree requirements, monitor academic progress and provide proactive support and academic success strategies. The advisor role assists students with registration and navigating academic policies and systems (e.g. Workday and Canvas) and refers students to appropriate campus resources. This position maintains accurate advising records and participates in advising-related trainings and meetings to support best practices for adult learners.

This position will also perform other related duties as assigned. (Since every duty associated with this position may not be specifically spelled out, employees may be required to perform additional duties considered incidental in the performance of this job.)

Minimum Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree and 1-2 years in academic advising, student services or administrative support. Must have the ability to work independently and collaboratively, manage multiple tasks, and maintain confidentiality. Must have proficiency with Microsoft Office and have strong communication, organization, and time management skills, as well as attention to detail in managing records, documents, and program logistics.

Preferred Qualifications: Experience in program operation or administrative support. Experience working with adult or non-traditional student populations. Familiarity with systems like Workday and Canvas and have an understanding of academic advising principles and practices, particularly for adult and non-traditional leaners. Familiarity with higher education administrative systems, policies and procedures is preferred.

Compensation: Base salary range is $46,000 - $48,000. The position is FLSA exempt. Western offers an excellent benefits package including shared premiums for a comprehensive health insurance plan, dental insurance, retirement plan, life insurance, and other insurance options. After one year of employment, Western provides free tuition for dependents enrolled full time in undergraduate programs for up to four years.

Application Procedure: Apply online at . Required attachments for online application include a letter of application addressed to Dr. Sally Cirincione, resume, and contact information for three references.

In compliance with the Colorado Job Application Fairness Act, in any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.

Please direct questions to the search committee chair at .

Application deadline is August 30, 2026.

Additional Information on Western and Gunnison/Crested Butte

Western Colorado University is a public institution with an enrollment of ~3,700 students. 47% of students are undergraduates, 33% are graduate students, and 80% receive some form of financial aid. Western students represent 17 countries, 50 states, and almost every county in Colorado. With an average class size of 17, Western’s faculty and staff share a strong commitment to personalized, rigorous, and immersive education. Visit to learn more about the university.

Western Colorado University is located in Gunnison, Colorado, about 200 miles southwest of Denver amidst over 2 million acres of public land and a vibrant ranching community. The Gunnison valley provides robust cultural programming and exceptional outdoor recreation. A network of dedicated community organizations enrich the lives of many in the tight-knit community. Living in the valley, one appreciates a vibrant culture of festivals, exhibitions, performances, wellness activities, and more. In the winter, many enjoy in skiing at Crested Butte Mountain Resort and along dozens of miles of cross-country trails. In the summer, bikers, hikers, and runners explore 750-plus miles of singletrack trails, while others delight in fishing, boating, and paddleboarding at Blue Mesa Reservoir or on the Gunnison River and its tributaries. Pre-K-12 students are served by the highly-ranked Gunnison Watershed School District.

jobs.excerpt: Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.
jobs.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

What this opportunity involves We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for

  • 5+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard

Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Compensation

Up to $50/hr equivalent, depending on level and pace. Tasks are estimated at ~20 hours each; you set your own schedule.

We're looking for a strategic, commercially-minded Customer Success Executive to join our Global SMB team. You'll own a book of small and medium-sized hotel clients — primarily across AMERS, but with exposure to customers in other regions — guiding them from trial through to long-term partnership.

This isn't a ticket-taking role. You'll be responsible for helping hoteliers hit the commercial goals that matter to them — direct bookings, conversion, revenue — and for spotting the moments where Triptease can do more for them. You'll run at scale, which means automation and AI aren't optional extras; they're how the job gets done well.

💼 What You'll Do

🚀 Own the Trial — Take ownership of the customer experience through the critical 3-month trial period. Set clear success criteria with each client, drive adoption and performance against them, and convert trials into full-term contracts. You'll continuously refine the onboarding playbook so new hotels see value faster, with less manual effort from you.

🎯 Be Their Strategic Partner — Act as the trusted advisor for your book of SMB hotels. Understand each client's commercial goals (direct booking revenue, conversion rate, parity position, channel mix) and build a point of view on how Triptease gets them there. Lead performance check-ins, business reviews, and training sessions that tie product usage to business outcomes.

🔒 Drive Retention and Renewals — Deliver high retention across the SMB base by demonstrating measurable value. You'll identify churn risk early, handle objections head-on, and work with Product and internal stakeholders to clear blockers before they become exits.

📈 Grow the Book — Spot upsell and cross-sell opportunities across your accounts: additional products, expanded ad spend, new properties. Partner with Sales to land expansion deals and grow net revenue retention across the segment.

🤖 Scale Yourself with AI — Apply the "Automate Everything" mindset to your own work and to the SMB playbook. Use AI tools to multiply your impact — summarizing performance, drafting communications, triaging at-risk accounts — so you spend more time on the strategic work only a human can do.

🤝 Work Across Teams — Partner with Product, Marketing, and Sales to feed back customer insight, shape the SMB experience, and launch one-to-many campaigns. You'll report on client performance, trial conversion, retention, and expansion to senior management.

🗂️ Keep the Data Trustworthy — Maintain accurate, current records across Vitally, Salesforce, and our other CS systems so the wider business can rely on your numbers.

Requirements

  • The "Automate Everything" Mindset: You are obsessed with efficiency and hate doing the same manual task twice. You approach work with this logic:
    At SMB scale this is the whole job. With a large book of accounts, the CSE who builds a reusable performance template or an automated risk trigger will always beat the one working account by account. We give you AI tools and the freedom to use them — we expect you to.
    • First time: You solve it and wonder if it will happen again.
    • Second time: You build a template or tool to automate the majority of the task.
    • Third time: You actively work to automate the process from start to finish so you never have to do it manually again.
  • Commercial Instinct: You think about customer success in terms of business outcomes — revenue, conversion, retention — not just usage or sentiment. You're comfortable reading performance data and translating it into a conversation a GM or Revenue Manager actually cares about.
  • Experience: 2+ years in Customer Success, Account Management, or a similar client-facing role, ideally in B2B SaaS. Experience managing SMB books at scale — high account count, recurring automated touchpoints — is a strong plus.

  • Language: Full professional fluency in English, both written and spoken, is required. You'll communicate daily with U.S.-based customers and colleagues, including leading client meetings, delivering presentations, and discussing nuanced commercial and technical topics.
  • AI Adopter: You're already using AI tools in your day-to-day work and you're curious about what's next. You see AI as a force multiplier, not a threat.

  • Communication: Strong written and verbal communication. You can run a video training session, write a tight renewal email, and flag risk to leadership without burying the lede.
  • Adaptability: You thrive in a fast-paced environment where product, process, and priorities evolve.

Strategic Resource Planning

Onboarding and Resource Integration

Resource and Database Management

Job Description:

We are Omnissa!

Omnissa is the first AI-driven digital work platform, built to support flexible, secure, work-from anywhere experiences. We integrate industry-leading solutions—including Unified Endpoint Management, Virtual Apps and Desktops, Digital Employee Experience, and Security & Compliance—into a seamless, autonomous workspace that adapts to how people work. Our platform boosts employee engagement while optimizing IT operations, security, and cost.

Guided by our Core Values—Act in Alignment, Build Trust, Foster Inclusiveness, Drive Efficiency, and Maximize Customer Value—we’re growing rapidly and committed to delivering meaningful impact. If you're passionate about shaping the future of work, we’d love to hear from you.

At Omnissa, we are committed to maintaining a fair, consistent, and secure hiring process for all candidates. As part of this approach, we use standard interview and verification practices designed to ensure alignment and protect both candidates and the organization. These practices are applied thoughtfully and with respect for candidate privacy.

What is the opportunity?
As an Associate Counsel, Americas Commercial, you will be responsible for supporting the Americas Deal Management and Sales Teams to ensure that all agreements are drafted and negotiated in accordance with company policies and legal requirements. This person will work with their Americas colleagues, the global Omnissa Legal Team, and stakeholders across the rest of the company to understand key issues and challenges in the commercial space, as well as stakeholder requirements, that impact the company’s agreements, in support of achieving the company’s strategic goals and objectives. Here is a breakdown:

  • Drafting, reviewing and negotiating agreements with customers (including but not limited to licensing of entitlements to on-premises software and cloud-hosted services, as well as consulting and professional services agreements) in coordination with the Omnissa Deal Management Team and other internal stakeholders as needed.
  • Proactively providing legal advice and support to the Deal Management and Sales teams with regard to customer requests for modification to Omnissa standard terms, and deal-related questions, using sound independent judgment to resolve routine matters and escalating novel or higher-risk issues to senior counsel as appropriate.
  • As required, provide guidance and support to internal stakeholders on sales contract-related matters, including interpretation of contract terms, addressing customer concerns, and resolution of disputes.

What will you bring to Omnissa?

  • Qualified to practice law in a US jurisdiction.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience negotiating software and cloud services licensing agreements, and related professional services agreements at a B2B company. In-house experience in a United States-based technology company preferred but not required.
  • Excellent drafting and negotiation skills with the ability to communicate complex legal and commercial concepts clearly and concisely.
  • Ability to identify and mitigate legal and business risks and provide practical solutions to complex issues to support Omnissa corporate strategies.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities with attention to detail.
  • Collaborative mindset with the ability to work cross-functionally and build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Bonus points if you have experience using AI tools in your daily legal work.

Location: United States with preference in Mountain View, CA
Location Type: Hybrid or Remote (Location Dependent)
Travel Expectations:<5%
Education: Juris Doctor, preferred, or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.

The typical base salary for this role is between USD $98,250-$174,650 per year and it may be eligible for participation in a corporate bonus program. Actual compensation offer may vary from posted hiring range based upon geographic location, work experience, education, skill level, or other relevant factors. In addition to competitive compensation, Omnissa offers a variety of benefits such as employee ownership, health insurance, 401k with matching contributions, disability insurance, paid-time off, growth opportunities, and more.

In addition to some of the world’s largest enterprises and government agencies, more than 30% of the world’s top MSSPs rely on our platform. We’re at the forefront of protecting organizations against sophisticated cyber threats using cutting-edge AI and automation technologies. Our culture is built on diversity, openness, and collaboration, fostering creativity and innovation that drives real impact in the market.

We are seeking a highly collaborative and customer-focused Product Manager, UX to help drive the user experience strategy and execution across our cybersecurity platform. This role bridges Product Management, UX Design, Engineering, and Customer Success to create intuitive, scalable, and impactful experiences for security professionals.

The ideal candidate understands how to simplify complex cybersecurity workflows into elegant user experiences while balancing business priorities, technical feasibility, and customer needs. You will play a key role in defining product requirements, user journeys, platform usability, and workflow optimization for enterprise security teams. This is an excellent opportunity for someone passionate about cybersecurity, human-centered design, and solving complex operational challenges for enterprise customers.

Please note, as part of our interview process, we may invite candidates for an in-person interview to meet with our team.

Responsibilities

  • Product Ownership: Drive a cohesive, intuitive, and persona-aware experience that scales across our growing product portfolio. Partner with Product, Design, Engineering, and Security teams to define and deliver UX-focused product initiatives from concept through launch and ongoing optimization. Intimately understand customer needs and conduct discovery sessions, usability studies, workflow analysis, and user interviews. Translate complex technical security concepts into intuitive product experiences. Advocate for accessibility, usability, scalability, and design consistency across the platform.
  • Measure & Improve: Define and monitor KPIs related to product usage, adoption metrics, time-to-value, user engagement, and drop-off. Use qualitative and quantitative feedback to iterate and improve experiences. Analyze customer feedback, usage analytics, support trends, and market insights to identify areas for improvement.
  • Execution: Create and maintain product requirements documents (PRDs), user stories, acceptance criteria, and workflow documentation. Serve as the primary point of coordination across product, design, and engineering. Drive roadmap prioritization for UX improvements, workflow automation, and customer experience enhancements. Collaborate closely with UX/UI designers to develop wireframes, prototypes, and user flows. Work with Engineering teams throughout Agile/Scrum development cycles. Support go-to-market initiatives by partnering with Marketing, Sales Engineering, and Support teams.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of Product Management experience with cybersecurity technologies such as SIEM, SOAR, MDR, XDR, IAM, Cloud Security, Endpoint Security, or Vulnerability Management.
  • Strong understanding of UX principles, customer journey mapping, and user-centered design methodologies.
  • Experience working closely with UX/UI design teams and engineering organizations.
  • Ability to translate customer pain points into scalable product solutions.
  • Experience writing detailed product requirements and managing Agile development processes.
  • Deep domain expertise with enterprise security operations, SOC workflows, or cybersecurity platforms.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience with product management and collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, Figma, Miro, Product board, or similar.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Human-Computer Interaction, Design, or related field.

Desired Skills

  • Customer empathy and design thinking mindset
  • Experience with data visualization and dashboard usability
  • Strong cross-functional leadership abilities
  • Ability to thrive in fast-paced startup or high-growth environments
  • Excellent presentation and storytelling skills
  • Strategic thinking combined with execution focus
  • Data-driven decision making
  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills

Benefits

We pride ourselves in recognizing our employees. Here are some examples of our benefits program:

  • Pre-IPO Stock Options
  • Medical, Dental & Vision care
  • 401(k)
  • Life Insurance
  • Paid time off
  • Referral Program
  • Rewards and Recognition Program

jobs.title: AI Evaluation Engineer (Python, QA or Security)
jobs.excerpt: Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.
jobs.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

What this opportunity involves We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for

  • 5+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard

Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Compensation

Up to $40/hr equivalent, depending on level and pace. Tasks are estimated at ~20 hours each; you set your own schedule.

Job Description

We are seeking a Pharmacy Sales Consultant.

The Pharmacy Sales Consultant (PSC) is an individual contributor sales professional responsible for the selling of our portfolio of products and services into community pharmacies within an assigned geographic territory. The PSC is a highly consultative role requiring the ability to effectively lead all interactions with the pharmacist in charge and/or business owner of the pharmacy. The PSC will develop the appropriate strategy for each assigned account, prospect, and lead the coordinated execution of various products and services throughout the sales process. The PSC will position McKesson as a trusted and expert partner. This is a field-based position with daily customer and prospect facing responsibilities within the region, so extensive travel with some overnights required.

The Pharmacy Sales Consultant focuses on retaining independently owned community and Alternate Site pharmacies through a high level of customer satisfaction and cultivating the customer through in-depth growth strategy and Enterprise Solutions within our portfolio of products and services. The Pharmacy Sales Consultant also uses a robust knowledge of our value proposition to win new, profitable business. As a sales consultant, it is vital to understand the current industry and customer opportunities or challenges and well as have a collaborative relationship with peers and cross-functional departments to provide guidance and expertise to the customer. The territory for this position will cover Maryland, and areas of West Virginia. The ideal candidate will be in the Baltimore metro area.

This role serves as a technical and operational partner responsible for executing automation initiatives, managing implementation projects, supporting process improvement efforts, and ensuring automation solutions meet business requirements. This role focuses on automation delivery, stakeholder coordination, vendor collaboration, testing, deployment, and ongoing optimization across revenue cycle functions.

At this time, US Anesthesia Partners does not hire candidates residing in California, Hawaii, or Alaska.

The base pay estimate for this role is $89,000 - $151,300 annually. The final offer will depend on the skills, experience, and qualifications of the selected candidate. This range is for base pay only and does not include bonuses or other compensation. This position is eligible for an annual bonus. Bonuses are not guaranteed and are awarded based on company and individual performance.
