jobs.excerpt: FormAssembly is a data collection platform that helps organizations collect, use, and be good stewards of the personal data entrusted to them.
jobs.description:
FormAssembly is a data collection platform that helps organizations collect, use, and be good stewards of the personal data entrusted to them. Higher Ed institutions, nonprofits, healthcare systems, FinServ companies, and government agencies use FormAssembly to build secure web forms, automate workflows, and connect data directly into the systems they already run on — Salesforce chief among them.

That means the problems arriving in Support are rarely simple. A form that will not submit might be a styling conflict, a conditional logic error, a Salesforce field mapping problem, or an authentication failure three layers down. Figuring out which is the job.

About the role

As a Senior Technical Support Specialist, you handle the technically demanding end of the customer queue and help the people around you get better at doing the same.

You will spend most of your time solving customer problems over email and chat — the tricky ones, where the answer is not in an article, and the cause is not obvious. You will read browser console errors, inspect form configurations, trace Salesforce integration failures, and reproduce issues before you escalate them. When something does need to go to Tier 2 or Engineering, you scope it well enough that nobody has to start over.

The rest of your time goes to raising the team's ceiling: mentoring newer Specialists, contributing to documentation and troubleshooting guides, watching the queues for trends worth flagging, and helping new hires get oriented.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You will not manage anyone. You will influence a lot.

What you'll do

  • Resolve customer issues over email and chat, focusing on the technically complex end of the queue
  • Diagnose problems across web forms, conditional logic, styling, and integrations rather than matching symptoms to articles
  • Troubleshoot Salesforce integration issues — field mappings, error messages, object relationships, connector configuration
  • Reproduce issues and scope them clearly before escalating to Tier 2 or Engineering
  • Monitor queues and Slack for trending problems and release-related issues, and escalate patterns early
  • Answer teammates' questions in Slack and act as a go-to resource for Specialists working through hard cases
  • Mentor newer team members, including through the Support Buddy program for new hires
  • Write and improve internal documentation, troubleshooting guides, and process notes
  • Contribute to weekly case reviews and help raise case quality across the team
  • Assist with form moderation and bad-actor review
  • Share customer feedback and product friction with Support leadership, Product, and Engineering

How you'll spend your time

  • 70% in the queue, resolving customer cases against team goals
  • 20% on team development — mentoring, continuing education, training new hires, and documentation
  • 10% in meetings — team, department, and a standing 1:1 with your manager

About you

  • You like puzzles and were born to troubleshoot. A problem nobody has seen before is the good part of your day, not the bad part.
  • You are genuinely kind to customYers who are frustrated, confused, or under deadline pressure.
  • You translate complex technical detail into plain language without talking down to anyone.
  • You write clearly. Most of your work will be read, not spoken.
  • You are comfortable saying "I do not know yet, here is how I will find out."
  • You enjoy helping teammates get better, and you are patient with people who are earlier in their learning than you are.
  • You work well independently and know when to pull someone in rather than spinning.
  • You notice patterns. When the same issue arrives for the third time, you want to fix the cause, not just the case.

Requirements

  • 2+ years in a technical, customer-facing support role, with demonstrated experience troubleshooting beyond documented procedures
  • Strong written communication — clear, warm, and technically accurate
  • Experience diagnosing issues in a web-based SaaS product
  • Salesforce experience as a power user or administrator
  • Comfortable working remotely with reliable and secure internet access

Technical skills — required

  • HTML — reading and interpreting form structure, embedded forms, iFrame publishing
  • CSS — diagnosing styling conflicts and selector specificity issues
  • JavaScript — reading errors and understanding form logic and dynamic behavior; you do not need to write applications from scratch
  • Browser developer console — independent error diagnosis and DOM inspection
  • Salesforce — field mappings, error interpretation, object relationships, connector configuration
  • Ticketing systems — clear bug reports with reproduction steps and severity assessment

Nice to have

  • Salesforce Administrator certification
  • REST API literacy, or experience with Postman or similar tools
  • Familiarity with DNS, SSL, or email deliverability troubleshooting
  • Experience supporting customers in regulated industries — healthcare, Higher Ed, government, or FinServ
  • Chat support experience alongside email

Salary range: $62,000 - $65,000
Must be in the United States

Benefits

FormAssembly is a completely remote/distributed team. We thrive through digital communication, and work to connect numerous times a day. Our culture is vibrant, fun, and unique! Read more about it here. Some of our benefits include:

  • Health benefits (health, dental, vision) for Team Members based in the United States

  • 9 paid company holidays

Weekday is an AI-native recruiting platform. We are backed by Y Combinator and Venture Highway (now General Catalyst). We have built the largest white collar talent database in India and have built tools to run outbound recruiting campaigns to them.

About the role

This is a growth role, not a strategy role. You will sit next to the CEO and own one number: revenue growth for one of our core product lines. Everything you do — every piece of content, every cold email, every demo call — either moves that number or it doesn't.

You won't be handed a playbook, a team, or a warmed-up pipeline. You'll build the GTM engine yourself: figure out which channels work, build them, and scale the ones that do. Some weeks that means writing content and tuning SEO/AEO so buyers find us. Other weeks it means running demo calls back-to-back and following up aggressively until deals close. If you think of yourself as either "a marketer" or "a salesperson" but not both, this isn't for you.

What you'll actually do

On any given day you might be:

  • Running the full inside-sales motion — taking demo calls, handling objections, following up relentlessly, and closing
  • Building content that actually converts: landing pages, comparison pages, blog posts, and material designed to rank on search and get picked up by AI answer engines (AEO)
  • Setting up and running outbound systems — cold email, cold calls, LinkedIn, or whatever channel gets us in front of the right buyers
  • Writing scripts and light automations to scale yourself — scraping lead lists, wiring up email sequences, building dashboards so you know what's working
  • Testing a new growth channel, killing it fast if it doesn't work, and doubling down if it does
  • Reporting your numbers honestly to the founders, including the ugly ones

You'll be measured on revenue — pipeline created and deals closed. Not on activity, not on slides.

What we're looking for

  • You can sell. You're sharp on calls, you can run a demo that lands, and you follow up like the deal depends on it — because it does.
  • You know your way around code and tech. You can write a script, wire up an API, or build your own tooling instead of waiting for an engineer.
  • You've done growth before — content, SEO, cold email, cold calling, or any sales system you built and ran yourself — and you can show what it produced.
  • You take ownership. When the number is yours, it moves — no follow-ups needed.
  • You work hard and sweat the details. Conscientiousness isn't optional here; the follow-up you skip is the deal you lose.
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity. No playbook, no hand-holding, no fully-defined role. The role is what you make it.

What you get

  • Full ownership of a revenue line — you're not a cog in a GTM machine, you are the GTM machine
  • A daily working relationship with the CEO and Cofounder, and a front-row seat to how a profitable, venture-backed startup grows
  • The freedom to pick your channels and build your own systems — and the accountability that comes with it
  • The kind of zero-to-one growth experience that's worth far more than the title

jobs.excerpt: Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.
jobs.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

About the Role

You’ll design coding tasks that challenge frontier AI coding agents. Each task is a self-contained Docker environment with a broken piece of software; an AI agent attempts the fix; automated tests verify the outcome. Your deliverable is the full task package: broken code, tests, instructions, and a reference solution proving the task is solvable.

Responsibilities:

  • Invent a realistic developer scenario — a real bug, a broken ETL, a missing feature — not a toy problem.
  • Build a reproducible Docker environment with pinned dependencies.
  • Write a pytest that verifies outcomes, not specific commands — deterministic, non-flaky, and does not leak the fix.
  • Write an instruction.md that reads like a Jira ticket a developer would receive.
  • Write a reference solve.sh proving the task is solvable.
  • Calibrate difficulty so current state-of-the-art agents solve the task 20–60% of the time.
  • Iterate based on feedback from expert QA reviewers.
  • Later: review other authors’ tasks as a QA reviewer.

Not in scope

  • Data labeling, prompt engineering.
  • Production code to ship — you design problems and verification for AI agents.
  • Leetcode puzzles — scenarios must look like real developer work.
  • Not every candidate task ships — quality over quantity.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of production software development in one backend stack — Python, Go, Node.js, Java, or Rust. Depth in one stack beats breadth.
  • Python + pytest fluency — required regardless of primary stack. The task harness is pytest-based even when the broken app is in another language. Fixtures, parametrize, monkeypatch, timeouts, conftest.py.
  • Docker authoring — reproducible Dockerfiles, pinned dependencies, multi-stage builds when needed, non-root user.
  • Linux & Bash — comfort debugging inside containers (strace, lsof, journalctl); shell beyond set -euo pipefail.
  • AI coding agent experience — Claude Code, Cursor, Roo Code, or similar, on non-trivial work. You can cite a specific time the AI was confidently wrong and how you caught it.
  • English — B2+ written.

Not a fit

  • Data Science, ML, or Computer Vision engineers without backend-engineering output.
  • Manual QA testers without automation or test authoring.
  • Frontend-only, low-code / no-code, IT Support, or Business Analysts.
  • Engineers who have never written pytest from scratch.
  • Junior, intern, or assistant as the most recent role.

Preferred qualifications

  • Domain depth in Security, System Administration (nginx / systemd / cron), Scientific Computing (NumPy / PyTorch / SciPy), DevOps, or Git internals.
  • Modern Python tooling (uv, poetry, pyproject.toml).
  • Coverage tooling (pytest-cov, coverage.py, gcov, llvm-cov, kcov).
  • Fuzzing or property-based testing (Hypothesis).
  • Prior contribution to agent-evaluation benchmarks or related frameworks.

Process

Apply → Pass qualification (90-minute sample-task screen + short behavioral interview) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid.

Time commitment

  • Onboarding: ~10 hours per first task.
  • Steady state: ~5 hours per task, 2–4 parallel tasks per author.
  • Realistic weekly load: 8–20 hours. Higher volume available for top performers.
  • You choose when and how to contribute; tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet acceptance criteria.

Compensation:

  • Paid contributions, rates up to $35/hour*.
  • Task-based compensation equivalent to hourly rate, depending on performance and volume.
  • Some projects include incentive payments.

*Rates vary based on expertise, skills assessment, location, project needs, and other factors. Higher rates may be provided to highly specialized experts. Lower rates may apply during onboarding or non-core project phases. Payment details are shared per project.

Apply

Submit your CV via the Mindrift platform. Indicate your English level, note this role (Software Engineering Evaluation Specialist — Terminal Bench), and include a GitHub profile link if available.

jobs.description:
About Us

Founded in Montreal in 2018, nesto is a Canadian fintech company on a mission to make property financing positive, empowering, and transparent from start to finish. We began as a digital mortgage broker and became Canada's leading direct-to-consumer online lending platform. Through Nesto Cloud, our B2B, cloud-native, end-to-end mortgage technology platform, we empower financial institutions, credit unions, and commercial real estate lenders with intelligent automation, real-time compliance, and seamless integrations across the full lending lifecycle. Together with CMLS Financial, we form the Nesto Group: more than $73 billion CAD in residential and commercial mortgages under management, 1,300+ team members, 12 offices across Canada.

Work Location and Time Zone

This is a remote-first role open to candidates anywhere in Canada. We strongly prefer candidates who can work Eastern Time hours. If you are based elsewhere in Canada and have worked Eastern hours before, we still want to hear from you.

Why This Role Exists
We need someone to support the tactical side of QA delivery by bridging the gap between component-level testing and end-to-end validation before client UAT. Working closely with a Senior QA Automation Developer, this person will help define what should be automated, prioritize test coverage based on client impact and business rules, review automation results, and support bug triage, product follow-up, and client updates during UAT. Our team uses the following tools on a daily basis: Playwright, Postman, Datadog, Docker, ArgoCD, GitHub, TypeScript, and MySQL.

What This Role Is Not

  • This role does not require someone to be a strong coder and may not involve coding as a core part of the job. It is not the right fit for someone looking for a fully hands-on automation engineering role.
  • This is not a role for someone who prefers a reactive approach and waits for development to finish before getting involved.
  • This is not a role for someone who prefers to work in isolation and doesn't want to improve broader team workflows, documentation, or quality processes.
  • This is not a role for someone who isn't ready to bring AI tools into their daily work.

The Career Path For This Role

  • Automation track: an opportunity to grow into a more hands-on automation engineering role over time.
  • QA coordination track: a path toward QA coordinator or test lead-type responsibilities, with more ownership over testing coordination and delivery.

What Success Looks Like

  • Within 90 days, you've built pre-UAT test coverage and scenarios, and are running that coverage independently with a clear read on where gaps remain.
  • Within 90 days, you're actively owning bug triage and tactical coordination during UAT, closing the loop with the client.
  • Within six months, you've helped define what should be automated and why, working in close partnership with the automation function so coverage decisions are shared rather than siloed.
  • You consistently contribute to test strategy and coverage decisions, not just execution — making sure quality holds up end to end, not just sprint by sprint.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Design test coverage and scenarios ahead of UAT, validating that the solution solves the customer's actual problem, not just individual feature specs.
  • Partner with developers and product managers across the SDLC to clarify requirements, catch gaps early, and define clear acceptance criteria.
  • Break down business and data requirements from product and design specifications (URDs, PRDs, HLDs) into comprehensive test plans.
  • Recommend what should be automated and why, working closely with our Automation Developers to shape coverage rather than build it yourself.
  • Investigate automation failures and follow up on results, flagging gaps and priorities.
  • Work with Delivery leadership and stakeholders to prioritize testing and coverage against client needs.
  • Own tactical bug triage and coordination during UAT, acting as a primary point of contact for client-reported issues.
  • Review and run tests using test management tools, giving the project team feedback on automation suitability.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of QA experience in a Senior Quality role, testing SaaS/cloud applications, with a deep understanding of the full SDLC and how Quality Engineering fits into development.
  • Strong end-to-end and functional testing experience, with the ability to evaluate a solution from the customer's point of view, not just against a spec.
  • Cross-module investigation skills – comfortable tracing an issue across multiple systems or teams to find the root cause.
  • Experience coordinating testing tactically during high-visibility periods (e.g., Pre-UAT, UAT), including tickets, status reporting, and resolution tracking.
  • API testing experience using Postman is a must – this is a technical role, though hands-on coding is not required.
  • Comfortable reviewing automation run results and investigating failures (e.g., reviewing CI/CD pipeline runs like GitHub Actions) to understand what's covered and what isn't, even without writing the automation yourself.
  • Agile fluency and comfort with rapid release cycles.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience in a fast-paced, innovative SaaS environment (startup-to-scale-up) rather than slower-moving industries.
  • Comfortable working extensively with PRDs and understanding the weight they carry in sign-off and approval.
  • Some coding background or interest, which could open a path toward automation work over time.

Interview Process

  • Recruiter Screen (30 min): An intro call to learn about your background and give you a real picture of the role.
  • Discovery Call (45 min): A conversation with the hiring manager to dig into your experience and assess mutual fit.
  • Take-Home Assignment: A chance to showcase your skills through a practical exercise relevant to the role.
  • Case Study Interview (60 min): A deep dive into your submission, with time to get to know some team members and ask about the role and company.
  • Final Interview (60 min): You'll meet with the recruiter and two additional stakeholders for a final conversation before a decision is made.
  • Offer Stage: Pending successful background, criminal, and reference checks, you'll receive a formal offer to join the team.

What We Offer

  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Top-tier extended health, dental, and vision coverage, featuring 100% drug coverage.
  • Health & Wellness Spending Account: A $1,500 combined annual flex fund for things like gym memberships or extra medical needs.
  • Generous Paid Time Off: 4 weeks of vacation plus 8 personal floater days.
  • Retirement Savings: Access to a group RRSP/DPSP plan featuring competitive company-matching contributions.
  • Telemedicine Services: Access via Dialogue and coverage for licensed practitioner services.
  • Family Support: Robust Maternity and Parental Leave Top-Up programs.

Why Join Us

The mortgage industry runs on legacy systems, slow processes, and information nobody can see. We are changing that by building better technology. nesto is a place for builders, problem-solvers, and curious minds – people who move fast, embrace innovation, and believe we're stronger together. This is the place for you if you trust your skills and want to build technology that reshapes an entire industry. An entrepreneurial culture built on trust, speed, uncomfortable ambition, being stronger together, and a relentless obsession with our clients. We also do not think building with AI belongs to engineers. Every function here is expected to automate its own repetitive work, and you will have support to do it.

Our Track Record

  • Hypergrowth: Deloitte Fast 50 – 3 years in a row
  • Tech community credibility: TechTO Canadian Rocketship 2025
  • Industry leadership: CLA Lending Company of the Year – 4 consecutive years
  • Talent magnet: CMP Top Mortgage Employer 2025

Diversity and Inclusion
At nesto, we believe that creativity and collaboration are the result of a diverse team. We are committed to fostering a culture of diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging, and we strongly encourage women, people of color, LGBTQIA+ individuals, and individuals with disabilities to apply. Here's what you'll be doing:

You'll conduct real-time video consultations with patients via the Fresh platform, assess their suitability for cosmetic injectable treatments, and where clinically appropriate and within your endorsed scope of practice, prescribe Schedule 4 medicines and issue treatment authorisations for Fresh Clinic treating nurses.

The core work centres on three things: thorough patient consultation and medical assessment, informed consent and collaborative treatment planning, and clinical documentation maintained to the highest standard. Clinical Decision-Making & Collaboration

  • Nurse Collaboration: Partner directly with treating nurses on clinical decision-making and holistic treatment planning.
  • Treatment Authorisations: Exercise professional judgment to approve, modify, or decline treatment plans, issuing authorisations with specific conditions or limits via the Fresh platform.

Governance, Documentation & Quality Assurance

  • Contemporaneous Documentation: Maintain thorough records for all consultations—including declined treatments—and capture informed consent using app templates.

The practical things:

  • Demonstrated experience in cosmetic and aesthetic medicine
  • Sound working knowledge of Ahpra's non-surgical cosmetic procedures and telehealth guidelines, and the NMBA Nurse Practitioner Standards for Practice
  • Current professional indemnity insurance in your own name, meeting NMBA standards and covering telehealth consultation, prescribing, and cosmetic practice, plus run-off cover

Great extras:

Bei TE Connectivity geben wir Ihnen Raum zur beruflichen Entfaltung, und die Möglichkeit über Länder und Kulturen hinweg mit Kollegen zusammenzuarbeiten, mit dem Ziel eine sicherere, nachhaltige, produktive und vernetzte Zukunft zu gestalten.

Jobübersicht

Für unser Technik-Team im Außendienst suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Field Application Engineer (m/w/d) – Energietechnik für das Gebiet Nord-/Westdeutschland.

In dieser abwechslungsreichen Position arbeiten Sie eng mit unseren Kunden, dem Vertrieb sowie internen Fachabteilungen zusammen und unterstützen bei der technischen Auslegung, Einführung und Anwendung unserer Lösungen im Bereich der Energieversorgung. Sie agieren als technischer Experte, treiben die Entwicklung kundenorientierter Lösungen voran und leisten einen wichtigen Beitrag zur erfolgreichen Positionierung unseres Produktportfolios.

Dabei entwickeln und vertiefen Sie Ihre Marktkenntnisse rund um unsere Lösungen in den Bereichen Nieder-, Mittel- und Hochspannungskabelzubehör, Straßenbeleuchtung, Vergussmaterialien, Anschlusstechnologien der Primärtechnik sowie Anwendungslösungen der Sekundärtechnik.

Es handelt sich um eine Remote-/Home-Office-Position mit regelmäßiger Reisetätigkeit.

Stellenanforderungen

  • Technische Unterstützung der Vertriebsorganisation bei Kunden im deutschsprachigen Raum
  • Durchführung von Produktvorstellungen und praktischen Vorführungen
  • Technische Auslegung und Neuanlage von Produkten gemäß Spezifikationen

  • Erstellung von Montageanleitungen und Stücklisten für neue Produkte und Produktmodifikationen

  • Technischer Ansprechpartner für Kunden sowie interne Fachabteilungen

  • Unterstützung von Professional Services und Produktmanagement bei Produktentwicklungen
  • Unterstützung bei der Marktbeobachtung sowie bei der Positionierung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Energielösungen

Was Sie mitbringen sollten:

  • Abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung mit entsprechender Weiterbildung oder Berufserfahrung (z. B. Monteur mit mindestens 5 Jahren Berufserfahrung, Techniker oder Meister)
  • Berufs- und Montageerfahrung im Bereich Nieder-, Mittel- und Hochspannungstechnik, idealerweise mit Kabelgarnituren für die Energieversorgung
  • Erfahrung mit Anwendungslösungen der Sekundärtechnik, insbesondere im Schaltanlagen- und Stationsbau
  • Sicheres und professionelles Auftreten gegenüber Kunden auf unterschiedlichen Hierarchieebenen
  • Verhandlungsgeschick und Erfahrung im Umgang mit technischen Entscheidungsträgern von Vorteil
  • Kenntnisse der relevanten Marktstandards und Anforderungen oder die Bereitschaft, sich diese anzueignen
  • Kenntnisse des Produktportfolios von TE Energy sowie des Wettbewerbsumfeldes sind von Vorteil
  • Hohe Eigeninitiative, Kundenorientierung und selbstständige Arbeitsweise
  • Belastbarkeit und Flexibilität in einem dynamischen Umfeld
  • Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
  • Gute MS-Office-Kenntnisse
  • Reisebereitschaft innerhalb des Vertriebsgebietes und zu Kundenstandorten vor Ort

Kompetenzen

Werte: Integrität, Verantwortlichkeit, Inklusion, Innovation, Teamarbeit

ÜBER TE CONNECTIVITY

TE Connectivity plc (NYSE: TEL) ist ein weltweit führendes Industrie- und Technologieunternehmen, das eine sicherere, nachhaltige, produktive und vernetzte Zukunft ermöglicht. Als verlässlicher Innovationspartner entwickelt TE Konnektivitäts- und Sensorlösungen, die die Verteilung und Übertragung von Strom, Signalen und Daten unterstützen und Innovationen in den Bereichen Transport der nächsten Generation, Stromnetze, industrielle Automatisierung, KI-Rechenzentren und vieles mehr vorantreiben. Mit mehr als 90.000 Mitarbeitenden, darunter 10.000 Ingenieurinnen und Ingenieure, arbeitet TE Seite an Seite mit Kundinnen und Kunden in rund 130 Ländern zusammen. In einer Welt, die sich rasant weiterentwickelt, bleibt TE seinem Leitsatz treu: EVERY CONNECTION COUNTS. Erfahren Sie mehr auf und auf LinkedIn, Facebook, WeChat, Instagram und X (ehemals Twitter).

Wir freuen uns Ihnen ein spannendes Gesamtpaket anbieten zu können, das auch flexibel auf sich wechselnde Lebenssituationen angepasst werden kann – das Wohlbefinden unserer Mitarbeiter steht an oberster Stelle!

Job title: Medical Science Liaison

About the Job:

Sanofi’s Medical Science Liaisons (MSLs) are externally facing scientific partners that transform medical practice and shape the healthcare ecosystem using a data-driven, AI-enabled approach to deliver personalized scientific engagement to Healthcare Organizations, Healthcare Providers, and Clinical Researchers. MSLs support our products and disease states throughout the product life cycle, maximizing the impact of our innovative medicines to improve patient lives.

Join the team transforming care for people with immune challenges, rare diseases, cancers, and neurological conditions. In Specialty Care, you’ll help deliver breakthrough treatments that bring hope to patients with some of the highest unmet needs.

About Sanofi:

We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

Main responsibilities:

  • Build engagement plans, in collaboration with field partners, that drive internal collaboration to generate field insights, share knowledge and expertise that inform strategic decision-making

  • Be the trusted scientific partner to external experts, decision-makers, and organizations through timely scientific engagement with an aim to enhance the understanding of the scientific and medical value of our products and pipeline

  • Conduct quality scientific presentations to educate healthcare providers on disease state and treatment landscape. Communicate in an accurate, fair and balanced manner, the benefits, risks, appropriate use and clinical value of our products

  • Engage with clinical investigators to support Sanofi’s pipeline and investigator sponsored studies (within compliance standards) within territory

  • Respond to unsolicited request for medical information associated with supported products and disease state area

  • The most important responsibilities of the job. For each key responsibility the action to be taken, the result to be achieved, and how it will be achieved. Included is the % of time spent on each responsibility.

External Engagement (80%):

  • Use data-driven decision making by using CRM data & insights to drive timely scientific engagement to enhance the understanding of the scientific and medical value of our products and pipeline

  • Demonstrate proficiency using Scientific Engagement Model (SEM)

  • Conduct quality scientific presentations to educate healthcare providers on disease state and treatment landscape. Communicate in an accurate, fair and balanced manner, the benefits, risks, appropriate use and clinical value of our products

  • Navigate the health care environments at regional and local level

Internal Collaboration (5%):

  • Collaborate closely and compliantly with cross-functional matrix teams (e.g., Commercial/Marketing, Market Access, Medical Value & Outcomes, Office Based Medical) on internal projects and territory/account plans

  • Demonstrate medical solution-finding and value within the matrix team; active involvement and engagement during matrix meetings

  • Contribute tp internal project teams as assigned appropriately prioritizing external activities

  • Attend internal team meetings and manager 1:1 meetings

Administrative work (15%):

  • Document field interactions and insights in CRM with 2 business days

  • Monitor progress towards individual and team goals on monthly basis

  • Document Knowledge surveys in CRM following each interaction with MyFocus KOLs and High Burden HCPs

  • Create and maintain medical account plans in appropriate tool

  • Complete all company assigned trainings and certifications

  • Stay updated on emerging scientific and technological advances and regulatory requirements to inform strategic decision-making

  • Develop and maintain Scientific Engagement skills

  • Create, execute and update individual development plan.

About you:

Basic Requirements:

  • Advanced degree in a relevant scientific or medical field (MD, PhD, PharmD, NP, MS or equivalent clinical advanced degree)

  • Must reside in territory

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in a field medical or MSL role within the pharmaceutical industry, OR demonstrated clinical experience in hemophilia or a related hematology therapeutic area

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior MSL experience

  • Experience in hemophilia, hematology, or rare blood disorders

  • Prior experience working with healthcare systems, payers, KOLs, and clinical investigators

  • Familiarity with CRM tools and digital engagement platforms

  • Highly self-motivated with an entrepreneurial mindset

  • Biopharmaceutical Industry Knowledge 

Functional Skills:

  • Stakeholder Relationship Management

Leadership skills:

Why Choose Us?

The Director, GVAP, Solid Tumors Pipeline provides critical strategic insights and guidance to ensure pipeline assets meet future market access needs and maximize commercial potential. The person in this position will focus on identifying market access-related evidentiary gaps in clinical development plans that could result in a breadth of reimbursement inconsistent with planned labelled population(s) and/or pricing that does not sustainably support the business. The person in this role will work cross-functionally with relevant stakeholders to develop recommendations to close those gaps and/or for evidence generation that, if implemented, would result in optimizing reimbursement and pricing potential. The person in this role must be capable of estimating the impact of different clinical development scenarios on access and price potential. The person in this role will confer with the ED, GVAP, Lead Solid Tumors, to determine how and when to disseminate GVAP analysis and recommendations. Furthermore, the position will support portfolio prioritization exercises.

This is a senior role that is critical in setting the foundation for the Company’s future Solid Tumor (ST) product success in that the person in this role develops a strategic vision for the pipeline, which is informed by market access expertise and a deep understanding of the evolving needs of global payers.

Essential Functions of the job:

Pipeline Market Access Strategy Development:

  • Lead the creation and implementation of global pricing and market access strategies for ST pipeline products (typically but not exclusively Phase II and III assets), aligning with clinical and commercial goals.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to integrate access requirements into the development process, influencing trial design, endpoints, and evidence generation to meet payer needs.
  • Lead the collection and aggregation of feedback from all regions in which the Company operates and develop recommendations regarding clinical development and other evidence generation based on that feedback.
  • In alignment with the ED, GVAP ST, represent the GVAP ST perspective (aligned with Regions and/or focus markets and HEOR) to governance or oversight bodies of the Company (e.g., GPT, GBT)

Value Proposition & Evidence Generation:

  • Develop early value propositions that resonate with global payers and support future pricing, reimbursement, and access decisions.
  • Work closely with Clinical, Medical Affairs, and Health Economics & Outcomes Research (HEOR) teams to shape clinical trial design and evidence-generation strategies that align with target market access requirements.
  • Identify and prioritize evidence gaps; work closely with HEOR to ensure development of health economic models, burden-of-illness studies, and other data to address payer concerns and enhance product differentiation.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement:

  • If delegated by ED, GVAP ST, serve as the primary market access point of contact for one or more GPTs.
  • Collaborate with R&D, Commercial (incl. PSV), Medical Affairs, and Regulatory Affairs to ensure access-related insights and payer needs are integrated into the overall development strategy.
  • Provide input into clinical decisions and Business Development to ensure payer requirements are recognized, addressed and or additional evidence generated through other means, in support of the commercial strategy development expectations, trends and risks.
  • Engage with focus markets and regional access teams to ensure early alignment on access strategies and support local adaptation for specific market needs.
  • Working together with commercial, clinical, medical / HEOR and regional market access teams, align on early asset target product profile definitions and evidence required as well as planned value proposition that will support value positioning and reduce pricing and reimbursement uncertainties across all regions in which BeOne operates.

Pre-Launch Preparation:

  • Drive pre-launch planning for pipeline products, including the creation of early value toolkits and JCA relevant PICOs and early engagement strategies to optimize future access and reimbursement.
  • Support market access launch readiness through regular communication, training, and support to regional and affiliate teams, preparing them to engage with payers as the product nears market entry.
  • Support regional activities relating to regional asset in-licensing for early pipeline products.

Market Insights & Competitive Landscape Analysis:

  • Continuously monitor the solid tumor landscape, including competitor activities, evolving payer requirements, and regulatory changes that impact access and reimbursement.
  • Run analysis of payer insights, pricing trends, and market conditions to inform strategy adjustments and refine access plans.
  • Use global and regional insights to refine value propositions and enhance product positioning as the product advances through clinical phases.
  • Lead early pipeline consultation processes with payers across all regions (in collaboration with the regions and/or focus markets) (e.g., CADTH, NICE, etc.).

Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • No direct supervision, high level of cross functional and pan-regional collaborations with internal stakeholders.

  • BA/BS degree is required, MA/MS or higher preferred.

Qualifications:

  • BA/BS Degree with +10 years of related pharmaceutical experience is necessary with at least 5 years of direct experience in global/ regional or local Market Access functions. Experience from pipeline/early development and JCA preparation a strong advantage.
  • Deep experience in market access and payer engagement within the oncology therapeutic area, with a strong ability to develop and deliver value toolkits that support regional and affiliate teams.
  • Detailed understanding of global pricing & reimbursement landscape, including the interrelation of various region pricing guidelines, HTA and national reimbursement process and requirements.
  • Strong understanding of regional pricing requirements for coverage and reimbursement with the ability to manage complex cases and successfully address customer objections and questions.
  • Knowledge of health technology assessment methods / health economics (HE) modeling is an advantage
  • Ability to work effectively and communicate across multiple cultures and a breadth of functions and levels

This is a home-based role (applicants must reside in the UK), though occasional travel may be required for face-to-face meetings at various locations within the UK.

  • Ad hoc duties as required from time to time by the Senior Management Team.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret financial data and communicate findings clearly to non-finance audiences. Highly organised and meticulous, with excellent attention to detail and the ability to plan, prioritise and manage multiple workloads effectively. Able to work autonomously, use initiative and remain calm under pressure while accurately following instructions. Demonstrates strong written and verbal communication skills and maintains confidentiality, professionalism and integrity at all times.

· Qualified CIMA, ACCA or ACA.

· Proven administrative experience.

jobs.description:
ClassWallet, a leading financial technology company in the United States serving agencies delegated responsibility to manage public funds, is seeking to hire an Implementation Specialist to join our team.

Agencies use ClassWallet to get public funds to the right people, and ensure the funds are used for the right purpose. ClassWallet's suite of products and services empowers agency administrators to dramatically increase efficiency of funds distribution and spend compliance, reduce programmatic costs, maximize the full potential impact of the program, and satisfy the needs and expectations of policymakers, constituents and public reporting. ClassWallet has processed over $6.7 billion to date and serves public agencies across 39 states. In its 11+ years in operation, ClassWallet has completed over 12M transactions, funded 1.1M recipients, processed over 5M applications, and now serves 300+ state and local agency clients, supported by a team of 280+ full-time staff.

The Company has developed an industry-defining digital wallet solution which has gained rapid traction among state and local agencies and school districts across America. ClassWallet ranks as the 61st fastest growing software company on the prestigious Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing private companies and the 21st fastest growing financial technology company on the Deloitte Technology Fast 500 in 2023.

While the Company delivers immense business value, the social impact of ClassWallet is a fabric that runs through its mission and corporate culture. As a result of ClassWallet’s innovation, public programs run with exponentially more efficiency and the impact and breadth of the programs for the individuals they serve is dramatically higher. This mission complements the Company's mission-based culture with focus on gratitude and work-life balance.

About the Role

We are seeking a high-energy, strategic Implementation Specialist to lead the successful integration of ClassWallet’s solutions for our most valued partners. This isn't just a support role—it is a consultative leadership position. You are the architect of the customer’s initial success and the primary driver of long-term platform adoption.

As an Implementation Specialist, you don’t just follow a checklist; you own the project lifecycle. You will act as a trusted advisor to school districts, state agencies, and foundations, leveraging a deep understanding of their unique challenges to propose "out-of-the-box" solutions that align their workflows with our technology. Your goal is to turn complex onboarding into a seamless, value-driven experience that secures revenue and mitigates churn before it starts. This is a role for someone who is equally comfortable building relationships and rolling up their sleeves to get things done.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary lead during the critical first phase of the customer lifecycle, providing expert guidance on best practices for platform configuration.
  • Proactively identify opportunities for expansion and up-selling during the implementation phase by recognizing unmet customer needs and collaborating with the Client Success team to capture new revenue streams.
  • Anticipate potential roadblocks in the onboarding process. When issues arise, you don’t just report them—you propose creative, scalable solutions that keep the project on track.
  • Manage complex, multi-stakeholder implementations, including new and existing clients, ensuring all deliverables are met with precision and within established timelines.
  • Act as the "voice of the customer" for the Product and Engineering teams, synthesizing customer feedback into actionable insights for future platform enhancements.
  • You contribute to a scalable deployment playbook — finding ways to apply what's worked before rather than reinventing the wheel with each new customer.
  • Design and deliver high-impact training webinars and on-site training sessions that go beyond "how-to" and focus on "why," driving deep user buy-in.
  • Maintain meticulous records in HubSpot and other internal tools, ensuring a seamless hand-off to the post-implementation support teams.

What You Bring

  • Consultative Mindset: You don’t just take orders; you ask "why" and offer a better way.
  • Proactive Ownership: You see around corners and solve problems before the customer even notices them.
  • Exceptional Communicator: You can command a room (or a Zoom call) and translate technical jargon into business value.
  • Creative Agility: You think outside the box to solve "unsolvable" workflow hurdles.
  • Revenue-Focused: You understand that customer success is the primary engine for company growth.

Requirements

  • Experience: 3+ years in a client-facing implementation, consulting, or strategic account management role (SaaS experience preferred).
  • Analytical Prowess: Ability to interpret complex data and translate it into a compelling narrative for customers.
  • Tech Savvy: High proficiency in Microsoft Excel (data analysis) and Google Suite.
  • Proven Track Record: Demonstrated ability to manage high-stakes projects with multiple moving parts and demanding stakeholders.
  • Education: BA/BS degree preferred. Project Management Professional certification is highly preferred.

Benefits

ClassWallet is a positive, family-oriented team environment. Our focus is on encouragement, positive reinforcement, and gratitude. We work hard and are highly motivated to win but with a healthy perspective on life.

We offer an excellent salary and benefits commensurate with experience.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

What this opportunity involves We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for

  • 5+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard

Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Compensation

Up to $50/hr equivalent, depending on level and pace. Tasks are estimated at ~20 hours each; you set your own schedule.

jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Lead Full Stack Engineer owns the NBA platform's orchestration and state machine — the system that carries a decision from the moment it is made to the moment it is activated, delivered, and acknowledged across member engagement channels. Built in Node.js/TypeScript on the Temporal workflow platform, the solution manages durable workflow execution, long-running member journeys, and reliable action delivery through Transactional Outbox and Kafka-based event patterns. This role owns the critical path between decision generation, activation, delivery, and receipt processing, ensuring actions are executed correctly, consistently, and at enterprise scale. This is a hands-on technical leadership role: you write code, lead a small team of engineers and contractors, and are accountable end-to-end for the durability, correctness, observability, and timeliness of action delivery across the member journey.

Key Responsibilities

  • Pod delivery — Own end-to-end delivery for the orchestration pod: planning, execution, quality, and shipping on time.
  • Workflow orchestration — Design and build durable, long-running workflows on Temporal in Node.js/TypeScript that model the member action lifecycle, state transitions, scheduling, activation, and delivery outcomes.
  • Action delivery architecture — Own the end-to-end action delivery pipeline from decision publication through activation, delivery acknowledgment, and state reconciliation. Design and implement Transactional Outbox patterns, atomic persist-and-publish workflows, idempotency controls, retry/backoff mechanisms, dead-letter queue handling, and delivery receipt processing.
  • Activation integrations — Own the components that activate decisions to Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) and publish through Kafka output patterns to downstream channels. Define delivery contracts, activation guarantees, and receipt ingestion patterns that ensure reliable action execution.
  • Hands-on development — Contribute code alongside the team, including Temporal workflows and activities, Node.js services, Kafka producers and consumers, outbox processors, and integration services.
  • Technical decisions — Make the day-to-day architecture decisions for the pod, including workflow design, state machine modeling, retry and compensation strategies, idempotency, topic strategy, schema evolution, delivery guarantees, and API contracts.
  • Distributed systems reliability — Engineer for correctness in a highly asynchronous environment. Ensure exactly-once business intent through idempotent consumers, deduplication strategies, durable state management, safe retries, and graceful failure handling.
  • Observability and operations — Establish monitoring, tracing, alerting, and operational visibility across workflow execution, event publication, activation processing, and delivery acknowledgment pipelines.
  • Team leadership — Manage and mentor engineers and contractors; run code reviews, uphold engineering standards, and keep the team unblocked and moving.
  • Cross-team coordination — Coordinate interfaces with decisioning, the Action Library, activation systems, and the platform team; surface dependencies, integration risks, and operational concerns early.


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or relevant area
  • 6+ years of full stack software engineering experience, with at least 1–2 years in a tech-lead or senior-lead capacity.
  • Strong Node.js/TypeScript backend experience building production services.
  • Hands-on experience with workflow orchestration platforms, with Temporal strongly preferred (or comparable technologies such as Cadence, Step Functions, or Airflow for durable workflows).
  • Strong distributed systems fundamentals, including event-driven architectures, asynchronous processing, retries, idempotency, and failure recovery.
  • Experience designing and implementing Kafka producer and consumer patterns in production environments.
  • Experience building reliable event delivery systems using Transactional Outbox, event-driven integration patterns, or comparable messaging architectures.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead a small pod through delivery and be accountable for technical outcomes.
  • Experience operating cloud-native systems on Azure or equivalent cloud infrastructure using Kubernetes, containers, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Clear communicator who can represent the pod's architecture, delivery status, operational risks, and tradeoffs to technical and business stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Production experience with Temporal at scale, including workflow versioning, long-running workflow management, and operational lifecycle management.
  • Deep experience implementing Transactional Outbox patterns, delivery acknowledgment workflows, dead-letter queue management, receipt reconciliation, and exactly-once processing semantics.
  • Experience integrating Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) or comparable activation and engagement platforms.
  • Experience with Kafka ecosystem tooling, event schema governance, and large-scale event-driven architectures.
  • Familiarity with the wider NBA platform stack, including React/TypeScript, Java services, and Decision Intelligence systems.
  • Experience with Helm, Terraform, and Kubernetes-based deployment patterns.
  • Background in healthcare, insurance, or another regulated industry with PHI handling, auditability, and compliance requirements.

jobs.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT:

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for:

  • 5+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard:
Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

Requirements and benefits

Educational qualifications

  • A Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science / Data Analytics, Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning, Computational Linguistics / Natural Language Processing (NLP), Information Systems or other related fields.

jobs.description:
About the Company

Our client is a US-based mortgage company operating across multiple states, with a full-service team handling everything from initial borrower consultation through loan origination, processing, underwriting, and closing. As they scale, they are hiring a Senior Digital Marketing Manager to own paid media and lead generation from strategy through execution.

You will report directly to the Founder/CEO and be the single accountable owner of Google and Meta performance — high-budget campaigns, tightly tracked, ruthlessly optimized against cost per qualified lead. This is a senior, execution-heavy seat. You build strategy from scratch, launch campaigns from zero, and drive CPL down through disciplined experimentation.

If you have generated real mortgage leads — or leads for a comparable high-ticket financial product such as refinancing, home equity, or personal lending — at real CPLs on real budgets, and you can talk through your numbers without a deck to hide behind, we want to see your application.

Key Responsibilities

Paid Media Strategy & Execution — Google & Meta

This is the core of the role.

  • Own the full Google Ads strategy and execution across search, display, Local Service Ads, and Performance Max, focused on high-intent mortgage leads — purchase, refinance, and home equity borrowers
  • Own the full Meta Ads strategy and execution across Facebook and Instagram, including prospecting campaigns, retargeting funnels, and structured creative testing
  • Build, launch, and continuously optimize campaigns from the ground up — not simply manage what already exists
  • Write brief, compelling ad copy and creative direction tailored to the mortgage borrower at each stage of awareness
  • Manage campaign budgets efficiently, allocating spend across channels to maximize cost per qualified lead

Lead Generation & Pipeline Quality

  • Drive consistent, high-quality inbound mortgage leads to fuel the loan officer pipeline
  • Define, track, and optimize against lead quality metrics — leads that convert to consultations and funded loans, not just raw form-fills
  • Build and optimize landing pages and conversion funnels to maximize lead capture from paid traffic
  • Coordinate with the sales and loan officer team to bring lead quality feedback back into targeting, audience, and creative strategy
  • Understand mortgage borrower intent signals and use them to sharpen audience targeting and messaging

Marketing Strategy

  • Develop an integrated digital marketing strategy connecting paid search, paid social, and supporting channels into a single cohesive lead generation engine
  • Identify new channels, audiences, and tactics to reduce dependence on any one traffic source
  • Stay current on mortgage industry marketing trends, competitor activity, regulatory advertising requirements, and platform algorithm changes
  • Bring data-driven recommendations to leadership on budget, channel mix, and growth opportunities

Analytics & Reporting

  • Set up and maintain accurate conversion tracking using GA4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel and Conversions API, and CRM integration
  • Deliver clear, actionable performance reports covering spend, impressions, clicks, leads, CPL, and lead-to-close rates
  • Use data to identify what is working, what is not, and what to do next — and act on it without being asked
  • Proactively keep leadership informed on campaign performance on a consistent rhythm

Creative & Messaging

  • Develop ad creative, copy, and landing page content that speaks credibly and compellingly to the mortgage borrower audience — purchase buyers, refinance candidates, and home equity seekers
  • Run structured A/B and multivariate tests on headlines, visuals, offers, and CTAs
  • Ensure all messaging is fully compliant with platform policies, RESPA, TILA, and applicable mortgage advertising regulations — compliance is non-negotiable in this industry

Requirements

  • 5 or more years of hands-on paid media experience with a strong focus on Google Ads and Meta Ads
  • Demonstrated track record of generating mortgage leads, financial services leads, or high-ticket consumer leads at scale — mortgage and lending experience preferred; real estate, insurance, or comparable financial products accepted
  • Expert-level Google Ads proficiency across search, Local Service Ads, Performance Max, and smart bidding strategies
  • Expert-level Meta Ads proficiency including campaign structure, audience building, retargeting, creative testing, and iOS 14+ tracking workarounds (CAPI, aggregated event measurement)
  • Strong analytical skills — you make decisions from data, not instinct alone
  • Experience with conversion tracking setup including GTM, GA4, Meta Pixel/CAPI, and CRM attribution
  • Ability to manage significant monthly ad budgets with direct accountability for CPL and ROI
  • Self-directed remote worker with direct accountability to leadership
  • Professional written English suitable for CEO-facing reporting

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct mortgage industry marketing experience — borrower psychology, rate-sensitivity cycles, seasonal demand patterns, and common objections
  • Familiarity with mortgage compliance requirements for advertising — RESPA, TILA, NMLS disclosure requirements, and Fair Lending considerations
  • Landing page builder experience — Unbounce, Leadpages, or ClickFunnels
  • CRM familiarity for lead tracking and attribution — HubSpot, Salesforce, or a mortgage-specific CRM such as Velocify or Total Expert
  • Experience running geo-targeted and local campaigns for a multi-market lending or financial services company
  • Google Ads and Meta Blueprint certifications

Tools & Software

Primary Paid Platforms

  • Google Ads — Search, Display, LSA, Performance Max
  • Meta Ads Manager — Facebook and Instagram

Tracking & Analytics

• GA4 and Google Tag Manager

  • Meta Pixel and Conversions API (CAPI)

Landing Pages & CRO

  • Unbounce, Leadpages, or ClickFunnels

CRM & Attribution

  • HubSpot, Salesforce, or mortgage-specific CRM platform

Reporting

  • Looker Studio, Excel, or Google Sheets

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • You have run campaigns that generated real mortgage or financial services leads at a real CPL, and you can walk through the numbers in a conversation
  • You do not wait to be told what to test next — you look at the data, form a hypothesis, and run the experiment
  • Your campaigns are structured cleanly, tracked accurately, and reported on clearly without anyone chasing you
  • You are as comfortable building from scratch as diagnosing an underperforming account
  • You understand that in mortgage, lead quality and compliance matter as much as volume — and you optimize for all three
  • You proactively keep leadership informed on a consistent rhythm

Requirements

What We Offer

• Compensation up to $12 per hour

• 100% remote work

• Full-time role

This position develops and maintains collaboration among local agencies, community stakeholders, advocacy groups and political units, such as County Managers and Boards of Commissioners. The position serves as a collaborative partner in identifying system barriers, developing solutions, and leading related efforts in the assigned communities. This position works with other Vaya departments to address identified needs within the region.

As such, the individual filling this position shall be required to be trained regarding such laws and shall be required to observe those laws in his/her capacity as an employee of Vaya Health. POSITION SUMMARY

The NAACP Empowerment Programs, Inc., a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization for equal rights, seeks a Program Manager, Environmental and Climate Justice, who is a dynamic and innovative leader who has a foundational understanding of environmental and climate justice issues, can produce high-quality written work, gather and translate research and information for internal and external audiences and contribute to the overall strategic direction of the Association.

TheCenter for Environmental and Climate Justiceis one of the Centers of Innovation (C-HOPE) at the NAACP. The Center’s team of subject matter experts work with our robust national network of member units and their local communities to execute transformative strategies. The Center proactively disrupts the inequitable systems that disproportionately impact Black Americans. The Center responds to environmental and climate justice issues leveraging change levers through a comprehensive, multi-stakeholder advocacy approach.

The Program manager is a key member of the team, who assists in tracking and managing environmental and climate justice issues as outlined in the Center’s priority areas of work. Additionally, program manager is the day-to-day operational lead for administrative needs within the Center.

The ideal candidate has the capacity to work with the Director for the Center for Environmental and Climate Justice to carry out the goals within the Center and how the NAACP can address rapidly evolving challenges in the field. The ideal candidate has expertise in and knowledge of environmental and climate justice issues as well as complex short-term and long-term project management and campaigns. Attention to detail in work product, an ability to problem solve and think critically, and a high level of emotional intelligence is required.

  • Deliver high quality, timely work product.
  • Think strategically, anticipate challenges, envision growth, reflect thoughtfully, and embrace change.
  • Perform any other duties as assigned by the Director, Center for Environmental and Climate Justice or other designee.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education/Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent experience preferred.

This is not a traditional executive assistant role. You will be expected to build tools and automations independently using no-code and low-code platforms, configure cross-platform workflows, and proactively identify manual processes and replace them with scalable systems. You do not need a traditional engineering background, but you need to be genuinely comfortable building with AI tools and automation platforms. If you are operationally sharp, AI-native, and take pride in creating systems that eliminate repeated work, this role is a strong fit.

Why You'll Want to Join

  • You will be paid in USD (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)
  • Paid Time Off in accordance with company policy
  • Observance of Holidays per company guidelines
  • 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive

  • Direct access to the founder of an early-stage AI health technology company building across clinical and performance verticals
  • High-ownership role where your systems and automations directly shape how the company operates

What You'll Work On

Company Operating System

  • Build and maintain a centralized company operating system in Notion including documentation of goals, OKRs, meeting notes, and project context
  • Eliminate repeated conversations and scattered information by creating a single source of truth across the organization
  • Keep documentation current, organized, and easy to navigate as the company scales

AI Toolstack Implementation and Integration

  • Implement and integrate the company's AI-native toolstack including Grain for meeting recording, Attio CRM, Linear for task tracking, and other automation tools
  • Configure permissions, workflows, and integrations to ensure seamless cross-platform operations
  • Stay current on new tools and proactively recommend additions or replacements that improve operational efficiency

Process Automation

  • Audit and automate recurring operational processes on a regular cycle, proactively identifying manual tasks and replacing them with scalable systems
  • Use tools such as Claude, Cursor, Zapier, Make, or similar no-code and low-code platforms to build internal automations without requiring deep traditional engineering knowledge
  • Build automations such as auto-populating Linear from monthly goals and other cross-platform workflows that reduce manual effort

Chief of Staff Support

  • Track founder follow-ups, manage action items, and ensure nothing falls through the cracks across two distinct business verticals
  • Book travel, coordinate scheduling, and manage logistics on the founder's behalf
  • Maintain visibility across both business lines and surface blockers, priorities, and pending decisions proactively

What You Bring

  • Proven experience in an executive assistant, chief of staff, or operations role with a strong systems-building component
  • Demonstrated ability to build workflows and automations using no-code or low-code platforms such as Zapier, Make, n8n, or similar tools
  • Hands-on experience with AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor in a professional or operational context
  • Experience building and maintaining Notion workspaces including documentation, OKRs, and project management systems
  • Familiarity with tools such as Linear, Attio, or similar task tracking and CRM platforms
  • Highly organized with strong follow-through and the ability to manage multiple priorities across parallel workstreams
  • Proactive and self-directed with a bias toward building systems rather than managing tasks manually
  • Excellent written English communication skills

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting a founder or executive across multiple business verticals simultaneously
  • Background in an early-stage startup or high-growth technology company
  • Familiarity with Grain or similar meeting intelligence and recording platforms
  • Experience with basic scripting or prompt engineering to extend automation capabilities
  • Exposure to health technology, clinical operations, or performance and wellness industries

How to Apply

Please include:

  1. Your updated resume
  2. A short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes) introducing yourself, walking through a specific automation or system you built that replaced a manual process, and describing the tools you used and the outcome it produced

Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.

If you are genuinely AI-native, take ownership of operational infrastructure, and want to build the systems behind a company doing meaningful work in health technology, this role gives you the access and the latitude to do your best work.

Application Process Overview

Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients:

  1. Initial Application - Submit your application and complete our prequalifying questions
  2. Video Introduction - Record an video introduction to showcase your communication skills and work experience
  3. Role-Specific Assessment - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable)
  4. Recruitment Interview - Initial screening with our talent team
  5. Executive Interview - Meet with senior leadership to discuss role alignment
  6. Client Interview - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting
  7. Background & Reference Check - Professional reference verification
  8. Job Offer - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team

Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations. We'll keep you informed throughout the process and provide feedback at each step.

Scientific Games is the global leader in lottery games, sports betting and technology, and the partner of choice for government lotteries. From cutting-edge backend systems to exciting entertainment experiences and trailblazing retail and digital solutions, we elevate play every day. We push game designs to the next level and are pioneers in data analytics and iLottery. Built on a foundation of trusted partnerships, Scientific Games combines relentless innovation, legendary performance, and unwavering security to responsibly propel the global lottery industry ever forward.

Position Summary

Job Description Summary

As a CRM & Lifecycle Marketing Manager supporting both Loyalty and iLottery business growth, you will be responsible for developing and growing client capabilities while partnering with Scientific Games’ Growth Marketing and Loyalty teams and other key stakeholders. You will ensure the delivery of scalable, consistent, and effective CRM solutions across all jurisdictions. This role is responsible for the flawless execution of data-driven marketing programs, identifies opportunities for optimization, and leverages CRM technology—primarily Optimove—to increase player engagement, retention, and overall program performance.
Your mission is to maximize jurisdiction ROI and value of player relationships by designing and executing lifecycle-based CRM strategies that are personalized, measurable, and impactful.

Key Responsibilities

  • CRM Strategy & Execution
    • Define lifecycle strategies across onboarding, activation, retention, reactivation, loyalty engagement, and churn prevention.
    • Develop test-and-learn roadmaps and optimization plans based on jurisdiction business objectives.
    • Translate customer behavior and business goals into actionable CRM recommendations.
    • Identify new engagement opportunities, audience strategies, and personalized lifecycle enhancements across jurisdictions.
    • Create, manage, and optimize automated and calendar-driven CRM programs that drive incremental activity and revenue across all player lifecycle stages (new, active, inactive).
    • Develop workflows for email, push notifications, and other relevant channels tailored to player journeys.
    • Support onboarding of new jurisdictions, ensuring full understanding of CRM capabilities, limitations, and best practices.
  • Platform & Technical Leadership
    • Act as an internal Optimove expert, including platform and technical components. For example deep knowledge of Optimove data models, integration between components, new and future functionality, best practices, releases, and product roadmaps.
    • Support roadmap feature development and opportunity sizing.
    • Troubleshoot platform issues and recommend improvements based on evolving product functionality.
    • Assist in evaluating new channels, products, and platform functionality.
  • Analytics & Insights
    • Identify opportunities within our platform and player base to improve engagement and retention, providing actionable recommendations across jurisdictions accordingly.
    • Leverage customer behavior, historic campaign performance, and channel analytics to guide strategy and optimize campaigns.
    • Partner with the product team to support data mapping and segmentation initiatives and attribution calculations.
    • Translate campaign and player behavior data into actionable business insights and strategic recommendations.
    • Support monthly, quarterly, and annual business reviews through performance analysis and optimization planning.
  • Data Readiness & Segmentation
    • Partner with data, product, and analytics teams to understand available customer attributes and targeting capabilities.
    • Validate audience eligibility logic and segmentation requirements.
    • Identify data gaps and make recommendations to improve personalization and reporting capabilities.
    • Support documentation of customer data, attributes, and CRM-related business rules.
  • Collaboration & Enablement
    • Partner cross-functionally with marketing, product, iLottery, and loyalty teams to deliver integrated, high-quality campaigns.
    • Train and support loyalty CRM team members on Optimove usage, campaign development, and best practices.
    • Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders, clients, and external partners/vendors to align on business goals.

Qualifications

Qualifications

  • Proven experience in CRM, ideally within digital gaming, lottery, or consumer engagement industries.
  • Hands-on expertise with Optimove or similar CRM platforms (Optimove certifications a plus).
  • Familiarity with CRM data models, customer attributes, integrations, and marketing technology ecosystems.
  • Experience working with customer data, segmentation strategies, reporting, and marketing performance analysis.
  • Proficiency in building and executing automated workflows, segmentation, and personalization campaigns.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously with a focus on deadlines, quality, and measurable outcomes.

Why Join Us?

This is an opportunity to play a key role in transforming player engagement strategies across multiple jurisdictions. You’ll work at the intersection of marketing technology, data, and customer experience—driving measurable growth and building loyalty for one of the most innovative leaders in the lottery and gaming industry.

Physical Requirements

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, stand, walk, bend, use hands, operate a computer, and have specific vision abilities to include close and distance vision, and ability to adjust focus working with computer and business equipment.

Work Conditions

Scientific Games, LLC and its affiliates (collectively, “SG”) are engaged in highly regulated gaming and lottery businesses. As a result, certain SG employees may, among other things, be required to obtain a gaming or other license(s), undergo background investigations or security checks, or meet certain standards dictated by law, regulation or contracts. In order to ensure SG complies with its regulatory and contractual commitments, as a condition to hiring and continuing to employ its employees, SG requires all of its employees to meet those requirements that are necessary to fulfill their individual roles. As a prerequisite to employment with SG (to the extent permitted by law), you shall be asked to consent to SG conducting a due diligence/background investigation on you.

EDUCATION, CERTIFICATION, AND/OR LICENSURE:

EDUCATION, CERTIFICATION, AND/OR LICENSURE:

Job Title
