jobs.description:
Job Description

With support of other Clinical Research Manager's (CRMs) and/or Therapeutic Area Head (TAH) / Clinical Research Director (CRD), this role is accountable for the end-to-end performance and project management for assigned protocols in a country in compliance with International Council for Harmonisation Good Clinical Practice (ICH-GCP) and country regulations, our company's policies and procedures, quality standards and adverse event reporting requirements internally and externally.

The Associate Clinical Research Manager (aCRM) could be responsible for a particular study for a country or a cluster.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Main Point of Contact (POC) for assigned protocols and link between Country Operations and clinical trial team (CTT).
  • Responsible for project management of the assigned studies: pro-actively plans, drives and tracks execution and performance of deliverables/timelines/results to meet country commitments from feasibility and site selection, recruitment, execution and close out.
  • Accountable for performance for assigned protocols in a country in compliance with ICH/GCP and country regulations, our company's policies and procedures, quality standards and adverse event reporting requirements internally and externally.
  • Reviews Monitoring Visits Reports and escalates performance issues and training needs to Clinical Research Associate Manager (CRAM) and/or functional vendor and internal management as needed.
  • Performs Quality control visits as required.
  • Leads local study teams to high performance: trains in the protocol other local roles, closely collaborates with and supports CRAs as protocol expert and coordinates activities across the different local country roles ensuring a strong collaboration (including the Clinical Trial Coordinators (CTC), Clinical Research Associates' (CRAs) and Clinical Operations Managers (COMs).
  • Responsible for creating and executing a local risk management plan for assigned studies.
  • Ensures compliance with Clinical Trial Management Systems (CTMS), electronic Trial Master File (eTMF) and other key systems in assigned studies.
  • Escalates as needed different challenges and issues to TA-Head/CRD/ Country Clinical Quality Manager (CCQM) and or CTT (as appropriate).
  • Identifies and shares best practices.
  • Responsible for collaboration with functional outsourcing vendors, investigators, other external partners in assigned studies.
  • As a customer-facing role, this position will build business relationships and represent our company with investigators.
  • Supports local and regional strategy development consistent with long‐term corporate needs in conjunction with CRD, TA-Head and Regional Operations.
  • Collaborates internally with Headquarters (HQ) functions, regional and local operations, European Union (EU) Clinical Development, Pharmacovigilance, Regulatory Affairs, Global Medical and Scientific Affairs to align on key issues/decisions across the trials. Consult with Human Health as needed.

Extent of Travel: Up to 30% of working time.

Qualifications, Skills & Experience

Skills:

  • Knowledge in Project Management and/or site management.
  • Strong organizational skills with demonstrated success in related role or discipline required.
  • Requires ability to make decisions independently and oversee important activities relevant to clinical research activities according to predetermined global policies and commitments with the support, oversight and supervision of the TA-Head or CRD
  • Requires understanding of local regulatory environment.
  • Scientific and clinical research knowledge is required.
  • Understanding of clinical trial planning, management and metrics is essential as well as the ability to focus on multiple deliverables and protocols simultaneously.
  • Ability to function as a key link between Country Operations and Clinical Trial Teams
  • Communicates effectively and builds a collaboration spirit in a remote/virtual environment and across countries, cultures and functions.
  • Ability to manage processes (and controls), productivity, quality and project delivery.
  • Proficiency in written and spoken English and local language. The incumbent must be competent and effective in written and verbal communication.
  • Strategic thinking.
  • Ability to work efficiently in a remote and virtual environment.
  • Aptitude for building leadership skills that enable and drive alignment with the goals, purpose and mission of our Research & Development Division, Global Clinical Development (GCD) and Global Clinical Trial Operations (GCTO).
  • Ability to identify problems, conflicts and opportunities early, analyses and prepare mitigation plans and drive conflict resolution is critical.
  • Required to negotiate skillfully in tough situations with both internal and external groups; settle differences with minimum disruption.
    • Examples of common problems include:
      • 1) low patient recruitment
      • 2) inadequate staff to meet business needs
      • 3) performance or compliance issues
      • 4) resolution of conflictive situations.
  • Understand cultural differences.
  • Strong diplomatic and empathic skills to effectively build and maintain professional relationships with investigators and other stakeholders.

Qualification & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in science (or comparable)
  • 4+ years of experience in clinical research
  • CRA experience preferred
  • Immunology experience preferred

Job Description:

Web Developer – .NET, Blazor and Azure - C-SAM UK

C-SAM develops specialist asset management, rental, service, certification and operational software for customers operating across the UK and international markets.
We are currently investing heavily in the development of our next-generation web application framework. This framework will modernise our established Windows-based software and provide a scalable, secure and configurable cloud platform for both existing and new customers.
We are looking for a practical and experienced Web Developer to join our development team and help build, improve and deliver this new platform.

The Web Developer will work primarily on C-SAM’s newest web application framework, developing reusable components, customer-facing modules, integrations and core platform functionality.
You will work across the full development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, solution design, development, testing, deployment and ongoing improvement.
The role will also involve understanding and, where required, migrating functionality from our existing VB.NET, WinForms and SQL Server applications into the new web platform.
This is a hands-on development role suited to someone who enjoys solving real business problems, working with complex workflows and building software that is reliable, maintainable and easy for users to operate.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop and maintain functionality within C-SAM’s new .NET web application framework.
• Build reusable Blazor components, shared services and configurable application modules.
• Develop responsive and user-friendly web interfaces.
• Convert existing Windows application functionality into modern web-based workflows.
• Work with product owners, operational teams and customers to understand business requirements.
• Design and implement secure, scalable and maintainable solutions.
• Develop and optimise Entity Framework queries and data access services.
• Create and maintain SQL Server stored procedures, views, functions and scripts.
• Improve application and database performance.
• Build integrations with customer systems, third-party APIs and cloud services.
• Assist with data migration, cleansing and validation activities.
• Develop authentication, role-based access and permission functionality.
• Support multi-company, multi-entity and multi-customer application structures.
• Write unit tests and assist with integration, regression and user acceptance testing.
• Diagnose and resolve software defects and performance issues.
• Review code and contribute to development standards and architecture decisions.
• Produce clear technical documentation and implementation notes.
• Support application deployments to Azure environments.
• Work with AI-assisted development tools, including OpenAI Codex, to improve development speed and quality.
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of the framework, development processes and coding standards.

Essential Skills and Experience

• Strong commercial experience developing applications using C# and .NET.
• Experience developing web applications using Blazor Server, Blazor WebAssembly, ASP.NET Core or a similar Microsoft web technology.
• Strong SQL Server knowledge, including:
o T-SQL
o Stored procedures
o Views
o Joins and aggregations
o Query optimisation
o Indexing
o Execution plans
o Data migration scripts
• Experience using Entity Framework or Entity Framework Core.
• Good understanding of object-oriented programming and software design principles.
• Experience developing REST APIs and integrating with third-party services.
• Experience with dependency injection and service-based application architecture.
• Experience using Git and source control workflows.
• Good understanding of application security, authentication and role-based permissions.
• Ability to investigate and resolve complex technical and business problems.
• Ability to work with existing applications and understand established business logic.
• Strong attention to detail and a focus on producing reliable, supportable software.
• Ability to work independently while also contributing effectively within a small development team.

Desirable Skills and Experience

The following experience would be beneficial but is not essential:

• VB.NET development experience.

• WinForms or WPF application development.
• Experience modernising or migrating desktop applications to web technologies.
• Crystal Reports development and support.
• Experience converting Crystal Reports into web-based or alternative reporting solutions.
• Microsoft Azure experience, including:
o Azure App Service
o Azure SQL Database
o Azure Storage
o Azure Functions
o Application Insights
o Key Vault
o Azure DevOps
o Microsoft Entra ID
• Experience with Microsoft Authentication Library (MSAL), single sign-on or multi-factor authentication.
• Experience building multi-tenant or multi-company SaaS applications.
• Experience with MAUI or cross-platform application development.
• Knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript and responsive web design.
• Experience with component libraries such as Ignite UI.
• Experience developing dashboards, charts and operational reporting.
• Knowledge of background processing, scheduled services and message queues.
• Experience with document generation, barcode printing, label printing or local printing services.
• Experience integrating accounting, shipping, CRM, ERP or asset management systems.
• Experience working with AI development tools such as OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot or Azure AI services.
• Knowledge of prompt design, AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation or vector search.
• Familiarity with secure software development practices and standards such as ISO 27001.
• Experience working within rental, asset management, service, maintenance, logistics or certification-based industries.

Technical Environment

The successful candidate is likely to work with technologies including:

  • C#
  • VB.NET
  • .NET and ASP.NET Core
  • Blazor Server
  • Entity Framework Core
  • SQL Server
  • Azure SQL Database
  • REST APIs
  • HTML and CSS
  • JavaScript
  • Microsoft Azure
  • Microsoft Entra ID and MSAL
  • Git and Azure DevOps
  • Crystal Reports
  • WinForms and WPF
  • .NET MAUI
  • OpenAI Codex and Azure AI services

Personal Characteristics

  • Practical and solutions-focused, with a passion for delivering business value.

  • Commercially aware, with the ability to connect technical solutions to business needs.

  • Confident working within complex and established technology environments.

  • Accountable, proactive, and committed to seeing work through to completion.

  • Focused on quality, maintainability, performance, security, and reliability.

  • Open to change, continuous improvement, and innovation.

  • Strong communicator with the ability to engage a wide range of stakeholders.

  • Adaptable and effective in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

  • Committed to the responsible use of AI and modern technologies to improve outcomes and efficiency.

Qualifications and Experience

• A degree or equivalent qualification in software development, computer science or a related subject is desirable.
• Equivalent commercial experience will also be considered.
• Previous experience in a commercial software development role is required.
• Experience delivering business-critical software to external customers would be advantageous.

Working Arrangements

This role will involve working closely with C-SAM’s development, operations, professional services and management teams.
The position may be office-based, hybrid or remote depending on the successful candidate’s location and experience.
Occasional travel may be required for team meetings, customer workshops, implementation support or training.
Some flexibility may occasionally be required when supporting international customers operating in different time zones.

What We Offer

• The opportunity to help shape a new application framework and product platform.
• A varied role involving new development, architecture, integrations and modernisation.
• Exposure to international customers and complex operational software.
• The opportunity to work with modern Microsoft and AI technologies.
• A small-team environment where individual contributions have a visible impact.
• Opportunities to influence technical direction, development standards and future products.
• Ongoing professional development and training.

Measures of Success

Success in the role will include:

• Delivering reliable functionality within agreed timescales.
• Producing maintainable and reusable framework components.
• Reducing defects and support issues through good design and testing.
• Improving application and database performance.
• Supporting the successful migration of Windows functionality into the web platform.
• Contributing positively to development standards, documentation and team knowledge.
• Using AI-assisted development tools effectively while maintaining appropriate code quality, security and review controls.
• Helping deliver a secure, scalable and commercially successful web platform.

Who We Are

At Trility Consulting®, we’ve built a strong, remote-work culture where people thrive, grow, and support each other – earning us Great Place to Work® Certification. Headquartered in Central Iowa, we embrace flexible schedules and collaboration across geographically distributed teams serving clients from all corners of the United States and globally.
We seek team members with the grit necessary to forge paths where none previously existed, to get back up when circumstances knock them down, to adapt to the changing needs of the client even when it is uncomfortable, and to deliver on our commitments. Candidates must respect and value people, recognize that over-communication is barely good enough, thrive on solving complex problems, have a passion for building teams, and know that delivering what a client actually values is more important than their own predispositions. They understand value proposition, love delivering value, and take pride in learning the expansive and ever-changing business of clients. Candidates are self-motivated and relentlessly working to become more today than they were yesterday.

About the Role

    Trility Consulting is actively seeking a Senior .NET Application Development Consultant who is an expert in their field and a powerhouse on the keyboard. In this role, you'll partner directly with Trility clients to design, build, modernize, and support production software solutions.

    You'll take clients from "napkin to production" by listening to their challenges with empathy, asking thoughtful questions, evaluating technical options, and using your problem-solving skills to discover the right approach. You'll own technical work from discovery and design through development, testing, deployment, and ongoing support while helping clients build stronger engineering practices along the way.

    You aren't just a developer for hire. As a Trility consultant, you'll be expected to understand the "why" behind the work, challenge assumptions when appropriate, communicate openly when something isn't working, and help clients arrive at solutions that balance technical excellence with business value.

    This is a remote W2 or 1099 position.

    At this time, Trility is only able to hire W2 employees who reside in the following states: Alabama, Colorado, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Minnesota, Missouri, Montana, Nebraska, Nevada, North Carolina, Ohio, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia, and Wisconsin.

What You Will Do

  • Partner directly with client teams to understand business challenges, evaluate technical options, and translate requirements into practical software solutions.
  • Design, develop, test, and support production-quality applications using .NET, C#, Angular, and modern full-stack development practices.
  • Contribute to architectural decisions across application design, APIs, event-driven systems, messaging, data synchronization, and user-facing experiences.
  • Take ownership of features and technical work from initial discovery and design through development, testing, deployment, and ongoing support.

  • Communicate technical decisions, tradeoffs, risks, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Adapt quickly to new technologies, frameworks, codebases, and client environments while maintaining a high standard for engineering quality.
  • Share knowledge with client teams and contribute to a collaborative environment where the goal is not simply to deliver software, but to leave the client better equipped to maintain and evolve it.
  • Take ownership of technical decisions, communicate tradeoffs, and confidently recommend solutions based on client needs, technical constraints, and long-term maintainability.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of professional full-stack software development experience with strong expertise in .NET and C#, along with the ability and desire to work across evolving technologies and technical environments.
  • Proficiency developing applications using Angular, with a strong understanding of components, services, modules, and related application architecture.

  • Demonstrated ability to quickly adapt to new coding environments, technologies, frameworks, and client-specific systems.
  • Demonstrated ability to take ownership of technical decisions, communicate tradeoffs, and recommend solutions that balance technical quality with client and business needs.

jobs.description:
At Mindera, we don’t just "write code."

We build products we are proud of, with people we love. Software Engineering Applications, including Web and Mobile, are at the core of what we do. We partner with our clients to deliver high-performance, resilient, and scalable systems that impact users and businesses worldwide.

We are a collection of individuals with different stories, but one shared goal: to build a place where we actually want to work. We value empathy, self-organization, and the courage to take risks. If you love solving complex problems and believe that teaching others is the best way to learn, you’ll feel right at home here.

The Role & The Challenge

We are looking for seasoned Senior .NET Developers who thrive in complex engineering environments, enjoy solving challenging technical problems, and take ownership of the software they build.

Reliability and quality are fundamental to our platform, so we're seeking product-minded engineers with proven experience in cloud-native distributed systems and a strong sense of ownership throughout the software development lifecycle.

In this role, you'll be expected to contribute to architectural decisions, clearly articulate the trade-offs behind your technical choices, and take features from business refinement through implementation, deployment, and production monitoring. You'll work with modern engineering practices to build decoupled, maintainable systems that scale reliably in production.

Your role goes beyond writing C# code. You are expected to own the delivery pipeline end to end:

  • Refinement: Challenge ambiguous business requirements, analyze acceptance criteria, and ensure technical feasibility.
  • Architecture: Design decoupled, scalable solutions using Event-Driven Architecture (EDA) patterns.
  • Execution: Write highly concurrent, thread-safe applications using .NET 8 or later, with a strong preference for composition over inheritance.
  • Verification: Treat Test-Driven Development (TDD) as an essential engineering practice by writing robust unit and integration tests using xUnit and WireMock to prevent regressions.
  • Delivery & Operations: Deploy through modern CI/CD pipelines and proactively monitor production telemetry using tools such as AWS CloudWatch, New Relic, and GitHub Actions to ensure rapid troubleshooting and operational excellence.

The Tech Stack

  • Core: C#, .NET 8+, ASP.NET Core
  • Architecture: Microservices, Event-Driven Architecture (EDA), Distributed Systems
  • Cloud & Messaging: AWS (ECS, EC2, SQS, SNS, S3)
  • Databases & Caching: SQL, NoSQL, Redis, Valkey, DynamoDB
  • Infrastructure & CI/CD: Terraform, GitHub Actions, TeamCity
  • Quality Assurance: xUnit, WireMock, SpecFlow

Requirements

You’ll be a Great Fit If...

  • Engineering Seniority: Solid experience designing and deploying complex, high-throughput backend systems using .NET.
  • Cloud-Native Expertise: Deep, hands-on experience with AWS, particularly containerized workloads (ECS/EC2) and messaging services (SQS/SNS).
  • System Design Mastery: Strong understanding of SOLID principles, dependency injection lifetimes, and the ASP.NET Core middleware pipeline.
  • Concurrency Discipline: Expert knowledge of asynchronous programming in C#. You understand how the thread pool works and why synchronous blocking (for example, using `.Result` or `.Wait()`) can severely impact the scalability and reliability of web APIs.
  • API Design: Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, idempotent operations, and global exception-handling strategies.
  • Communication: Advanced or fluent English, with the ability to clearly communicate architectural decisions and technical trade-offs to stakeholders and cross-functional teams.

It’s a Total Bonus If...

  • Production experience with streaming platforms such as Kafka, Kinesis, or RabbitMQ.
  • Strong understanding of AWS services and cloud-native architectures.
  • Practical experience with LLMs and Generative AI using .NET or Python, particularly for AI-assisted engineering workflows and SDLC automation.

Benefits

The Things We Really Care About:

  • Health Insurance, because health comes first
  • Flexible working hours
  • Open holidays, take the time you need for yourself
  • Profit distribution for everyone
  • Mindera Annual Trip, Sports, and sharing groups to connect and have fun!
  • Training & conferences, create your own training plan

Other Good Things :

  • Choose Laptop & Peripherals that best suit your needs
  • Hotspot with unlimited usage, for work or Netflix ;)
  • Remote culture: We have an office in Casablanca, but Minders work remotely from all over Morocco.
  • At the offices, we have a wide range of snacks to keep you fed and healthy and Partnerships with local businesses

Culture

Most of all you get to work with a bunch of great people, where the whole team owns the project together in a politics-free environment. Our culture reflects our lean and self-organization attitude. We encourage our colleagues to take risks, make decisions, work in a collaborative way and talk to everyone to enhance communication. Freedom and Responsibility go hand in hand, and we value commitment, feedback, and empathy.

About Mindera

At Mindera we use technology to build products we are proud of, with people we love.

Software Engineering Applications, including Web and Mobile, are at the core of what we do at Mindera.

We partner with our clients, to understand their products and deliver high-performance, resilient and scalable software systems that create an impact in their users and businesses across the world.

You get to work with a bunch of great people, where the whole team owns the project together.

Our culture reflects our lean and self management attitude. We encourage our colleagues to take risks, make decisions, work in a collaborative way and talk to everyone to enhance communication.

We are proud of our work and we love to learn all and everything while navigating through an Agile, Lean and collaborative environment.

jobs.description:
Senior C++ Software Engineer

Remote (UK-based) | Full-Time

About Us

Reactive Markets is the 2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year (). Our network handles over $50 billion in daily trading volumes across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency, connecting 40+ of the world's leading liquidity providers.

We build trading systems that operate at the edge of what's technically possible — where nanoseconds matter and a dropped message costs real money. Our engineering team is small, senior, and deeply invested in the craft of building cutting edge, reliable, high-performance systems.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior C++ Software Engineer who can shape the technical direction of our Switchboard trading platform while continuing to write excellent code. You'll work on the most performance-critical components — pricing engines, connectivity gateways, market-data systems, and the messaging layer that ties them together — and you'll have a direct influence on architectural decisions that affect the entire platform.

This is not a role where you write code and throw it over a wall. You build it, you test it, you deploy it, you support it in production, and you improve it. Our engineers own the full lifecycle — from design through to operational excellence. When something breaks at 4pm on a Friday, you're part of the team that investigates and fixes it.

Beyond your own delivery, you'll provide technical oversight across the team — reviewing designs, challenging assumptions, and mentoring engineers who are earlier in their careers. You'll help us maintain the quality bar that our clients depend on, and you'll contribute to the architectural decisions that determine how well our platform scales.

Occasional hours outside the normal working day are required for production releases, scheduled maintenance windows, and Level 3 support during critical incidents. We keep this to a minimum and recognise the commitment — but owning a production trading platform means being there when it matters.

What You'll Work On

  • Modern C++20 and Go on Linux — a modern software stack based on open source

  • Cloud-native infrastructure on AWS with colocation in key data centres

  • Microsecond-level latency optimisation and high-throughput messaging

  • Market-data and reference-data pipelines across multiple asset classes

  • FIX protocol integrations with global banks and liquidity providers

  • Observability and monitoring — dashboards, alerting, and metrics that make system behaviour visible

  • Production systems that handle real money — reliability is not optional

  • Architectural oversight — solution design, peer reviews, and technical direction for platform components

  • Mentorship — helping junior and mid-level engineers develop their skills, improve their code, and grow into stronger contributors

What We Need

Technical:

  • Strong C++ with Linux systems programming (5+ years)

  • Comfortable working close to the metal — you understand what's underneath your code

  • Proven track record of optimising complex, latency-sensitive systems — you can profile, diagnose, and fix performance problems methodically

  • Deep understanding of distributed systems architecture and network protocols (TCP/UDP, socket programming, FIX)

  • Experience with system design and architectural trade-offs — you've made decisions that stuck and lived with the consequences

  • Go experience is a strong bonus — we use Go extensively for microservices and command-line tooling, and you'll be expected to work with it internally. If you don't know it yet, strong C++ engineers pick it up quickly

  • Python for scripting, automation, testing, and data analysis — used across the platform for tooling and operational workflows

  • Git and shell scripting

  • Experience in financial services or trading technology is a plus but not essential

How you work:

  • You ship. You're delivery-focused — you iterate, you improve, you get things into production

  • You own it. When you build something, you take responsibility for its behaviour in production. You respond to incidents (15-minute acknowledgement SLA during working hours), investigate issues, and close the loop

  • You raise the bar. You conduct thoughtful peer reviews, challenge designs constructively, and hold the team to high standards without slowing it down

  • You mentor. You invest in the engineers around you — sharing knowledge, pairing on hard problems, and helping people grow. You make the team better, not just the code

  • You write things down. Documentation is not an afterthought — it's how we scale knowledge across a distributed team. If it's not written down, it doesn't exist

  • You communicate. We're a distributed team across multiple time zones. Clear, proactive communication — especially when things go wrong — is essential

  • You care about quality. You write clean, testable code. You review your peers' work thoughtfully. You push for continuous improvement without gold-plating

  • You embrace AI tooling. We use AI tools (Claude, Gemini) to amplify our engineering capability — from code review and debugging to incident investigation and documentation. You don't need to be an expert, but you should be curious and willing to learn

What You Get

  • Real problems — trading systems where performance is measured in microseconds, not user clicks

  • Technical influence — direct input into architectural decisions, solution design, and the technical direction of the platform

  • An excellent team — senior engineers who care about craft, collaborate openly, and hold each other to high standards

  • Ownership — small teams, clear accountability, direct impact on the platform and our clients

  • Competitive package — up to 30 days leave + bank holidays, private health insurance, pension, life insurance, dental/optical cashback, cycle to work, socials and offsites

  • Remote-friendly — work from home with flexibility. We trust our people to deliver

  • Sustainable pace — we work hard, but we don't burn people out. Balance is how we stay sharp

  • Growth — career progression to lead roles, performance specialisation, or technical leadership. We invest in people who invest in us

We believe in transparency, honest feedback, and writing things down. We celebrate delivery, not activity. We frame AI as empowering people — removing toil, amplifying capability, enabling higher-value work.

We aim to build systems that don't depend on the heroics of individuals to maintain and support — systems and processes that are resilient, documented, and sustainable.

Our Hiring Process

We keep our process focused and respectful of your time. Our process follows three stages.

Stage 1: Initial Conversation with Talent Acquisition

Format: Video call, ~30-45 minutes

Stage 2: Hiring Manager Conversation with the relevant team lead or hiring manager

Format: Video call, ~60 minutes

Stage 3: Technical Interview with two members of the relevant engineering team
Format: Video call, interactive session, ~60 minutes

What to expect in each stage will be explained by Talent Acquisition if you're invited to interview. Throughout the process, we aim to keep momentum with no unnecessary delays between stages, and feedback typically comes within a few business days.

*Please note that depending on availability, Stage 2 and 3 may swap around.

How to Apply

Please apply directly via this job posting — all applications, including those submitted via LinkedIn, are managed through our applicant tracking system, so you'll always land in the same place regardless of where you found this role.

Right to Work: Candidates must have the existing right to work in the UK. We are not currently able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Equal Opportunities: Reactive Markets is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

Reasonable Adjustments: If you need any adjustments or support during the application or interview process, please let us know — we're happy to accommodate.

Data Protection: By applying, you consent to Reactive Markets processing your personal data for recruitment purposes, in line with our privacy policy.

  • Design and scale Microsoft Entra ID Governance by implementing Access Reviews, defining governance processes together with business stakeholders and building script-based automation to roll out governance capabilities consistently across a decentralized Microsoft Entra environment.
  • Engineer secure workload identity services by automating the lifecycle of Service Principals, certificates, secrets and federated credentials, integrating directly with Azure Key Vault and ensuring every solution follows Least Privilege principles from day one.
  • Design and implement modern self-service capabilities for Service Principals, Entra Groups and delegated administration, enabling engineering teams to work independently without unnecessary ownership or excessive permissions.
  • Review and optimize Azure RBAC, Entra RBAC, application permissions, Microsoft Graph permissions and OAuth consent models to continuously reduce excessive privileges, strengthen identity governance and improve Redcare’s cloud identity security posture.
  • Build identity monitoring and detection capabilities to proactively identify expiring credentials, permission misuse and guardrail violations using Microsoft Sentinel, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics and Kusto Query Language (KQL).
  • Support the automation of Joiner, Mover and Leaver processes with HRIS as single source of truth for identity

About you

  • You bring hands-on experience designing and automating cloud identity solutions with Microsoft Entra, Administrative Units, Microsoft Entra ID Governance, Microsoft Graph Permissions, Azure, Microsoft 365 and Power Platform in complex cloud environments.
  • You enjoy engineering secure, scalable identity platforms and designing Zero Trust and Least Privilege architectures while balancing developer experience with enterprise security requirements. You naturally think in automation, APIs, governance and secure-by-design rather than manual administration.
  • You challenge unnecessary permissions and advocate for modern identity governance, Permission Misuse Detection and continuous improvement to build secure, scalable cloud environments.
  • You are curious about emerging identity technologies, enjoy experimenting with new ideas, sharing your knowledge and presenting technical concepts to colleagues and stakeholders. You collaborate across teams to continuously improve the way cloud identity is designed, governed, secured and automated.

About your benefits:

In order to provide you with the best possible support for your individual needs - whether it‘s living a healthy life, having enough time for your family, or developing your skills - we offer a wide range of different, site-specific benefits.

  • Welcome days: We want you to feel at home with us from the very first day. Therefore, we welcome you with our comprehensive onboarding program.
  • Remote working: While this is a remote position based in Germany, it may require occasional on-site collaboration at our offices in Berlin or Cologne, depending on business and team requirements.For our remote working employees we grant you 500,00 € to set up your office space from home. To create an environment for you and how you work best.
  • Anchor days: As per your remote contract there will be some occasions to travel to office for anchor days, this is fully reimbursed including any travelling costs or hotel expenses.
  • Personal development: Grow! We support and encourage your individual development through various in- and external trainings.
  • Employee referral program: Because you know best who fits in with us, successful recommendations are rewarded with a bonus.

About Redcare Pharmacy

As Europe’s No. 1 e-pharmacy, Redcare Pharmacy is powered by passionate teams and cutting-edge innovation. We strive to create a healthy, collaborative work environment where every employee feels valued and inspired to contribute to our vision: “Until every human has their health.” If you’re seeking a career that offers purpose and aligns with your values, join us and start your #Redcareer today.

About the role

We are looking for a Senior Cloud Identity Engineer to help shape the future of identity engineering in our Microsoft Cloud environment. You will build secure, scalable and highly automated identity solutions that empower decentralized teams to innovate independently while operating within clear governance, Zero Trust principles and Least Privilege guardrails.

As part of our Cloud & Security team, you will help define the future of identity across Azure, Data, ERP and AI platforms, driving modern approaches for human, workload and AI-driven identities. From Identity Blueprints and agent identities to enterprise-wide governance, you will have the opportunity to influence strategic cloud security initiatives and establish identity as the foundation of a secure, scalable and AI-ready cloud platform.

About the tech stack

Core technologies

You will work with a modern Microsoft Cloud identity ecosystem, leveraging technologies such as Microsoft Entra, Microsoft Graph API, Microsoft Entra ID Governance (including Access Reviews), Azure, Azure RBAC, Entra RBAC, Azure Policy, Azure Key Vault, Managed Identities, Enterprise Applications, App Registrations, Service Principals, Certificate Lifecycle Management, Administrative Units, Conditional Access, Identity Protection, Workload Identity Federation, Microsoft Sentinel, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Kusto Query Language (KQL), Microsoft 365, Active Directory (Core Services), OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect.

You will help design secure identity architectures with a strong focus on Least Privilege, Azure Policy, Guardrails and Governance, as well as Permission Misuse Detection & Identity Monitoring.

Automation is a key part of this role, using PowerShell and Bash, alongside Microsoft Graph API, Azure Functions or Logic Apps, to build secure, scalable identity solutions and governance processes that follow Zero Trust and the Least Privilege principle across Azure and Microsoft Entra services.

Nice to have

As we continue to evolve our cloud identity platform for AI-driven and autonomous workloads, experience with modern AI-assisted engineering tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Codex or similar AI coding assistants) as well as Microsoft technologies such as Entra Agent ID, Identity Blueprints and Microsoft 365 Agents / Copilot is considered a plus.

Position Summary:
Cloud Deployment Engineers focus directly on delivering Infrastructure-as-a-Service (IaaS), platform, and hybrid cloud solutions for Red River Professional Services (RRPS) customers. The RRPS Cloud team designs, implements, migrates, and optimizes secure, scalable, and highly available cloud environments across Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services (AWS). As a Senior member of the Cloud Team, you will lead project delivery efforts, cloud modernization initiatives, develop automation frameworks, mentor technical resources, and serve as a trusted advisor for customers adopting or expanding their cloud platforms. This role requires deep expertise in Azure and strong working knowledge of AWS services, architectures, migrations, networking, security, and operational best practices. .

Primary Position Tasks:

  • Lead cloud migration, modernization, and infrastructure deployment projects across Azure, AWS, and hybrid environments.
  • Design and deploy highly available, secure, and scalable cloud architectures utilizing Azure and AWS Well-Architected Framework principles.
  • Assess customer cloud readiness and develop migration and modernization roadmaps.
  • Implement and support hybrid connectivity solutions between on-premises datacenters and cloud providers.
  • Design and implement cloud networking solutions, including site-to-site VPNs, ExpressRoute, AWS Direct Connect, VPCs, Virtual Networks, routing, and segmentation.
  • Implement cloud VDI solutions in Microsoft Azure (AVD) and Amazon Web Services (Amazon Workspace).
  • Develop Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using Terraform, ARM/Bicep templates, and AWS CloudFormation.
  • Automate cloud deployments and operational tasks using PowerShell, Python, Azure CLI, and AWS CLI.

  • Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and escalation support for junior implementation personnel.
  • Participate in architecture reviews and contribute to cloud best practices and standards. 

Minimum Education/Certification/Experience Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience designing, implementing, and supporting Microsoft Azure environments.
  • 3+ years of experience designing, implementing, and supporting Amazon Web Services (AWS) environments.
  • Experience delivering multi-cloud and hybrid cloud solutions for enterprise customers.
  • Strong understanding of Azure and AWS networking, security, identity, compute, storage, backup, and monitoring services.
  • Experience performing cloud migrations from on-premises datacenters to Azure and/or AWS.
  • Working knowledge of cloud governance, cost management, and operational best practices.
  • Experience implementing Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and cloud-native automation tools.
  • Required Azure Experience:
    • Proven experience deploying and managing Azure Virtual Machines (VMs), including sizing, OS configuration, and performance optimization.
    • Strong understanding of Azure Virtual Networking, including subnets, network security groups (NSGs), route tables, and peering.
    • Experience configuring and managing VPN Gateways, ExpressRoute, and hybrid connectivity solutions.
    • Solid experience with Azure Load Balancers (Standard and Basic), Application Gateway, and Traffic Manager.
    • Deep understanding of legacy on-premises Windows Server architectures, including Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, AD CS and file services.
    • Experience with Azure Migrate, including assessment, replication, and cutover of workloads.
    • Proven track record of VM migrations to Azure, including lift-and-shift and re-platforming strategies.
    • Experience implementing and managing Azure Site Recovery (ASR) for disaster recovery scenarios.
    • Hands-on experience with Azure Backup, including policies, vaults, and recovery procedures.
    • Experience with deploying Azure Virtual Desktop
    • Optimizing and monitoring using Azure monitor and Log analytics
    • Experience with Azure Storage componants (storage accounts, storage tiers, etc)
    • Working knowledge of Azure Active Directory Domain Services (AAD DS) and integration with on-prem AD.
  • Required AWS Experience.
    • Proven experience deploying and managing AWS EC2 instances, including sizing, configuration, performance tuning, and lifecycle management.
    • Strong understanding of AWS networking concepts including VPCs, subnets, route tables, security groups, network ACLs, and Transit Gateway.
    • Experience implementing AWS Direct Connect, VPN connectivity, and hybrid networking solutions.
    • Hands-on experience with AWS storage services including S3, EBS, EFS, and FSx.
    • Experience implementing and managing AWS Backup and disaster recovery solutions.
    • Experience migrating workloads to AWS using AWS Migration Hub, Application Migration Service (MGN), and related migration tools.
    • Knowledge of AWS security services such as GuardDuty, Security Hub, Inspector, and AWS Config. 

Preferred Education/Certification/Experience:

  • Possess Sr. Level Active Directory experience
  • Strong knowledge of SAN and backup technologies
  • Experienced with networking and network/system security
  • In depth knowledge of Hypervisors, On-Prem Microsoft Core infrastructure services, Cisco, Palo Alto and other major vendors of infrastructure technology
  • Understanding of automation, IaaC, terraform and ARM templates, Powershell
  • Experience with SQL Server, Azure SQL a plus.
  • Experience with deploying and managing Azure Virtual Desktop with Nerdio for MSP a big plus.
  • Experience with Azure AI Foundry is also a big plus.
  • Influence and drive cloud related capabilities, solutions and opportunities in coordination with external partners, operations and application teams.
  • Design and implement secure cloud application environments with centralize identity management.

Knowledge and Skills:

Are you looking for a role that motivates and challenges you? Are you ready for an opportunity for growth? We hire people who challenge and hold each other accountable for living 3Cloud’s core values because they know that it will result in amazing experiences and solutions for our clients and each other.

Principal Architect - Data Platforms & Architecture (SME)

The Principal Architect in Delivery leads architecture for large Azure programs that span applications,
platforms, and data. You connect business goals to cloud modernization roadmaps, define architecture
frameworks, and guide multi-team execution.

At this level, you act as an organization-wide technical leader. You set technical direction across practices,
orchestrate cross-team discovery, keep designs aligned across multiple teams, and turn successful patterns
into reusable models. You promote strong engineering, automation, and AI-assisted practices, mentor Senior Architects and Delivery Architects, and help build an inclusive, continuously improving engineering culture while supporting clear investment and modernization decisions for 3Cloud and our clients.

Responsibilities:

Solution Architecture and Technical Leadership
• Lead architecture and technical strategy for large Azure programs and portfolios so solutions meet client goals for value, security, scalability, reliability, performance, and cost.
• Define modernization blueprints and reference architectures across applications, platforms, and data, including system and subsystem designs, patterns, and standards that simplify delivery and operations over time.
• Translate business and product strategy into cloud architecture roadmaps and execution plans that drive measurable outcomes and adapt based on production feedback and telemetry.
• Guide major architecture decisions across programs, promote shared design standards and reusable models, and resolve high-impact technical trade-offs.

• Use AI tools to accelerate discovery, design, code, tests, documentation, and analysis, and scale successful practices so teams adopt them consistently.

• Data Movement (ETL/ELT).

• Data Warehousing (Designing and Implementing, Azure SQL, Synapse).
• Azure Storage Technologies (Data Lake, Blob Storage).
• Data Governance (including Data Quality and Profiling, Master Data Management, and Metadata Management).
• Business Intelligence, including Reporting and Visualizations (Key Performance Indicators (KPI), and Scorecards).
• Predictive, Prescription, and Descriptive Analytics.
• Expert knowledge of Microsoft Azure technologies.

Delivery and Consulting Excellence:

• Lead or co-lead executive and senior stakeholder conversations on cloud modernization, platform strategy, AI adoption, and program roadmaps.
• Use structured problem solving to clarify scope, dependencies, risks, and trade-offs, and shape delivery plans that balance value, cost, speed, and long-term system health.

• Run structured decision-making forums (such as architecture reviews or steering committees) that produce clear decisions, documented rationale, and actionable next steps.
• Define architecture, discovery, and delivery frameworks and working agreements that support predictable, incremental delivery across multiple teams and time zones, including cadences, artifacts, escalation paths, and hybrid delivery guidelines.
• Align teams on shared outcomes, APIs, integration contracts, and operating models, ensuring crossteam dependencies are identified early, owned, and tracked through to completion.
• Support effective use of Agile methods at program scale so architecture, backlogs, and release plans support meaningful increments, stable team velocity, low defect escape, clear definitions of done, and course corrections based on telemetry and feedback.
• Track risks, technical debt, quality trends, and architectural drift across teams, and recommend adjustments that keep programs on track while balancing short-term delivery needs with long-term system health.
• Support cross-practice opportunity qualification and estimating using playbooks, benchmarks, and templates so the organization focuses on high-fit pursuits and improves proposal quality and confidence in value, risk, and margin.


Mentorship and Team Development:


• Mentor Senior Architects, Delivery Architects, and senior engineers, helping them grow systems thinking, architectural judgment, cross-team awareness, and their ability to lead multi-team initiatives.
• Provide architectural oversight across programs, modeling pragmatic decision-making, including when to keep solutions simple, when to standardize, when to extend patterns, and when to introduce new technologies.
• Help shape career paths and development plans for architects by clarifying expectations for operating at program scale and providing concrete examples of what “good” looks like.

• Help build a culture of psychological safety, inclusion, constructive feedback, and continuous improvement within and across teams, and support new ways of working that endure beyond a single project.


Growth and Innovation:


• Grow the company by identifying opportunities within your accounts across all our capabilities and pursuing them with the support of the account team.
• Intentionally build executive relationships within accounts to expand our partnership and create opportunities to provide strategic value.
• Drive sales opportunities by participating in pursuit teams as either the Pursuit Lead or Technical Solution Lead.

• Define and evolve reusable assets—such as reference architectures, modernization playbooks, landing zone templates, workshops, accelerators, and starter repositories—that become standard patterns for delivery teams and reduce cycle time and rework while honoring architectural and nonfunctional requirements.
• Champion adoption of modern frameworks, cloud platform capabilities, automation practices, and AIassisted tools in a responsible and secure way, using pilots and experiments with clear success criteria to turn innovation into stable, repeatable practice.

• Shape enablement programs that grow capabilities and reusable assets across accounts and package applied innovation into offerings and assets used in delivery and pursuits.

Requirements:

• Experience defining solution and platform architectures that connect business strategy with scalable technical design, strong delivery practices, and measurable outcomes.
• Experience leading hybrid and remote teams and working with multiple stakeholders across time zones while maintaining alignment, quality, and predictable delivery.

• Experience using AI-augmented development and integrating AI and machine learning capabilities into solutions (for example, using APIs, frameworks, or cloud-based AI services and tools for code, test, and documentation acceleration).
• Significant experience working in Agile or Scrum environments at scale, including backlog structuring, dependency management, integration planning, and release management.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with strong presentation, written, and verbal communication skills for both technical and business audiences.

We are seeking an experienced React Developer to design, develop, and maintain modern enterprise web applications that power customer-facing digital platforms, internal business portals, and cloud-native SaaS solutions. This role focuses on building highly responsive, scalable, and maintainable Single Page Applications (SPAs) using React while integrating seamlessly with enterprise APIs, cloud services, and microservices-based backend platforms.
You will collaborate closely with product managers, UX/UI designers, backend engineers, cloud architects, QA teams, and DevOps engineers to deliver exceptional user experiences across large-scale enterprise applications.   • Experience working with Git, GitHub, Azure DevOps, GitLab, or Bitbucket.
  • Experience using CI/CD platforms including GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps Pipelines, Jenkins, or GitLab CI.
  • Strong debugging and performance optimization skills using Chrome DevTools, Lighthouse, and browser profiling tools.
  • Experience consuming backend services built with .NET Core, Java Spring Boot, Node.js, or Python.
  • Experience working in Agile Scrum development environments.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience building enterprise SaaS platforms supporting thousands of concurrent users.
  • Familiarity with Next.js, Server-Side Rendering (SSR), Static Site Generation (SSG), and Incremental Static Regeneration (ISR).

  • Familiarity with cloud platforms including Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Experience with automated testing using Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress, Playwright, or Selenium.
  • Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and containerized application deployment.

  • Experience developing reusable enterprise component libraries and design systems.
  • Exposure to OpenTelemetry, application monitoring, and front-end observability tools.

Project Environment
You will be joining a digital engineering team responsible for modernizing enterprise applications and delivering cloud-native customer experiences. Current initiatives include:

  • Insurance policy management and claims processing systems

This is a hands-on engineering role where you will contribute to front-end architecture, UI development, API integration, testing, performance optimization, cloud deployments, and continuous enhancement of mission-critical enterprise applications.

  • Help evolve the front-end architecture, component patterns, and UI conventions of the product
  • Take loosely defined product ideas and turn them into clear, executable technical plans

  • Are highly skilled with React, TypeScript, and modern front-end development
  • Have strong product judgment and care deeply about user experience, interface quality, and the details that make software feel polished
  • Can work effectively in environments where requirements are not always fully specified up front
  • Know how to create clarity rather than waiting for it
  • Can break down ambiguous problems into sensible increments and ship value quickly

We're looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer who wants to build the interface layer of a product that's actually changing how lawyers work. You'll be shaping how legal professionals across Europe interact with AI-powered legal research, working on the kind of UI problems that don't have textbook answers: streaming AI reasoning, dense document interfaces, and search that has to feel instant on top of millions of legal sources. If you care deeply about craft, like ambiguity, and want a lot of room to shape what gets built, keep reading.

📍 This role can be based in our Copenhagen HQ or remotely from Europe.

About Pandektes

Legal research hasn’t changed much in decades. Lawyers still spend countless hours navigating fragmented sources, outdated systems, and complex databases just to find the information they need.

At Pandektes, we’re changing that.

Our ambition is to build the leading global platform for legal research and the largest AI-powered legal database. By combining artificial intelligence, intelligent search, and continuously updated legal sources, we’re redefining how legal knowledge is accessed, understood, analyzed, and applied.

Pandektes has raised more than €4 million and most recently closed a €2.9 million seed round (Feb 2025) led by People Ventures, Interface Capital, and leading angels. Pandektes already serves more than 350 customers across Denmark, Germany and Switzerland.

We’re still early in the journey, and joining our team now means you’ll have big impact on shaping how we scale.

About the role

You'll have real room to shape both what we build and how we build it. You'll work across our most ambitious surfaces: the document viewer where lawyers read and annotate legislation and case law, the AI chat that walks them through complex legal reasoning, and the search and navigation layer that ties it all together.

This is a role for someone who cares about craft. We move fast, but we don't ship sloppy. You'll partner closely with design, product, and our backend and ML teams to take features from rough idea to polished production experience, and you'll have meaningful influence on the technical direction of the frontend as the team grows.

What you’ll do

  • Own end-to-end implementation of frontend features in our React, Next.js, and TypeScript codebase, from architecture decisions to shipping polished UI

  • Build and maintain our most complex surfaces: AI chat with streaming reasoning, PDF and document viewers, modal stacks, search and navigation

  • Help shape our component library and frontend architecture as we scale our team

  • Partner with design and product to turn ambiguous problems into shipped features that legal professionals actually love using

  • Raise the bar for quality across the team through code review, technical direction, and shared standards

What you’ll bring

  • 5+ years of frontend experience, with deep expertise in React and TypeScript

  • Strong working knowledge of Next.js (App Router preferred)

  • Solid CSS fundamentals and comfort with a modern styling approach (Tailwind, CSS modules, or similar)

  • A track record of shipping complex stateful UIs in production, not just CRUD forms

  • Strong product instincts and design sensibility. You spot bad UX and propose better

  • Direct, low-ego communication. You give and take feedback well, and you lift teammates up

  • Curiosity about the domain - you want to understand the why behind what users need, not just build the ticket

Nice to have

  • Experience integrating with LLM APIs (streaming responses, tool calls, structured outputs)

  • PDF or document viewer work, annotation, or other heavy-content rendering

  • Design-system or component-library ownership

  • Accessibility (WCAG) experience

  • Some backend or full-stack comfort (Node, basic API work)

  • Legal-tech, fintech, or another regulated-domain background

How we work

We place great value on a vibrant, inspiring, and challenging company culture. This is achieved through a talented and passionate team that believes in achieving great things together.

We value ownership – you can expect a lot of freedom and responsibility. The key is open communication, trust, and a shared passion to transform the legal world.

We are a growing team based in our Copenhagen HQ and remotely from Germany, Switzerland, Austria and London. This role will be based in our Copenhagen HQ.

We believe diverse teams build better products and stronger teams. We embrace and encourage people from all backgrounds to apply regardless of race/ethnicity, colour, religion, nationality, gender, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, socio-economic status, culture or beliefs.

What we offer

About Utorg

Founded in 2019, Utorg builds the infrastructure for stablecoin payments: on- and off-ramps, self-custodial wallets, and crypto cards. Fully MiCA-authorized across the EEA. PCI DSS Level 2 certified. Backed by Dragonfly, TA Ventures, and Hypra.

Location: Remote

Tech stack: TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, TypeORM, NATS JetStream, Redis, Jest, Docker, Kubernetes, Google Cloud Platform.

Blockchains: EVM-compatible, Bitcoin-family, Tron, Solana, TON.

What you’ll do:
  • Own backend architecture across two large-scale microservice platforms (30+ and 25+ services) — from system design and API contracts to data flow and inter-service communication.
  • Lead complex integrations — payment providers, card issuers, blockchain networks, third-party APIs — and take full responsibility for their reliability in production.
  • Drive performance and scalability — identify bottlenecks, design caching strategies, optimize database queries, and ensure the platform handles growing load.
  • Shape technical direction — make architectural decisions, evaluate trade-offs, and influence the team’s engineering standards. You’ll partially offload the Tech Lead so the team can scale.
  • Build and improve AI-powered processes — our team actively uses LLM-based systems to automate operational and development workflows. You’ll contribute to and extend this direction.
  • Contribute to back-office frontends (~20% of your time) — maintain and extend React-based admin dashboards used by internal teams.
  • Own features end-to-end — from planning and architectural design to implementation, testing, production monitoring, and iterative improvement.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, QA, and cross-functional teams — produce clear technical documentation, participate in code reviews, and share knowledge.
  • Take part in a shared on-call rotation — roughly one week a month.
Who you are:
  • Technically strong with an architectural mindset — you don’t just write code, you design systems. You think about data flows, failure modes, and long-term maintainability before writing the first line.
  • Opinionated and able to defend your decisions — you bring an expert perspective to technical discussions and can articulate trade-offs clearly to both engineers and stakeholders.
  • Proactive problem-solver — you find issues before they become incidents and propose solutions without waiting to be asked.
  • Product-driven — most of your time goes into shipping features and solving real user problems, not open-ended refactoring.
  • Self-motivated and responsible — you thrive in small teams, enjoy autonomy, and take full ownership of the development process.
What you will bring:
  • 5+ years of production experience in backend development with Type Script/Node.js as the primary stack.
  • 2+ years with NestJS in production — modules, providers, middleware, guards, interceptors, microservice architecture with custom transports.
  • Deep PostgreSQL expertise — schema design, indexing (partial, GIN/GiST), query optimization, migrations with zero-downtime, database-per-service pattern.
  • Hands-on microservices experience — not a monolith split into modules. You’ve dealt with inter-service communication (RPC + pub/sub), message brokers, idempotency, eventual consistency, saga/outbox patterns.
  • System design experience — decomposing services, designing API contracts, data flow architecture, capacity planning. You can whiteboard a system and explain why you made each decision.
  • Complex integration experience — you’ve built and maintained integrations with third-party APIs, payment systems, or similar external services in production. You know how to handle retries, circuit breakers, and graceful degradation.
  • Performance engineering— profiling, caching strategies, load analysis, bottleneck identification. You can optimize a slow query and a slow service alike.
  • Production blockchain experience (MUST-HAVE) — you’ve worked with on-chain transactions, multiple networks, and real user funds. You understand HD wallets (BIP32/BIP39), smart contracts, ABI, ERC-20/SPL tokens, and the differences between account-based and UTXO models. Experience with libraries like ethers.js, viem, and solana/web3.js.
  • AI-driven development (MUST-HAVE) — you actively use AI tools (Claude, Copilot, Cursor) in your daily workflow. Beyond personal productivity, you have experience optimizing business or organizational processes with AI/LLMs—building automations, internal tools, or workflows powered by language models.
  • Strong testing discipline — unit tests (Jest), integration tests with real databases, microservice testing.
  • Security-conscious — in fintech and crypto, every code path can touch real user funds. You build accordingly.
  • Skilled in technical research — evaluating trade-offs, testing hypotheses, and making data-driven architectural decisions.
  • English proficiency at Upper-Intermediate. Fluent in the Russian language.
Nice to have:
  • Experience with NATS JetStream as a transport layer (streams, consumers, delivery policies).
  • Observability: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus + Grafana, structured logging (pino), distributed tracing.
  • Kubernetes beyond basics: Kustomize/Helm, deployment strategies, resource management.
  • Fintech domain knowledge: PCI DSS, GDPR, KYC/AML, payment systems.
  • Experience mentoring junior/middle developers.
  • React basics for back-office UIs (functional components, hooks, Redux, Material-UI).

Interaction with other teams:

Close collaboration with Product, QA, Frontend, and Mobile. Cross-functional communication is an essential part of the role. Partially offload the Tech Lead: own architectural and technical decisions, independently drive complex integrations, and influence the platform's technical direction. This is not an executor role. We need someone with strong expert opinions who can be relied upon for key technical decisions.

Key results (30-60-90):

30 days: First features shipped to production. Deep dive into the stack, architecture, and domain (blockchain, fintech). Clear understanding of core services and how they interact.

60 days: Independently drives a complex integration or a major feature. Participates in architectural code reviews. Brings first proposals for improvements.

90 days: Makes architectural decisions on their scope. Influences technical direction. Partially offloads the Tech Lead in decision-making. Participates in planning.

What we offer:
  • Work fully remote as part of an agile, international team reshaping the future of finance.
  • An engineering culture that encourages the adoption of modern tools and development practices, giving engineers real influence over technologies, workflows, and technical decisions.
  • Two career tracks — grow into Tech Lead or deepen your expertise as Staff/Principal IC. You choose the path.
  • Career progression and professional development in a forward-thinking fintech environment.
  • Competitive salary range based on individual performance review.
  • Transparent feedback and a culture that values ownership, open dialogue, and visible impact.
Recruitment Process

  1. Application. Submit your application and CV.

  2. Application Review. Our team reviews your experience and qualifications.

  3. HR Interview. An introductory conversation to discuss your professional background and expectations.

  4. Technical Interview. Assessment of your technical expertise, system design skills, and relevant experience.

  5. Team Lead Interview. A discussion focused on team fit, collaboration style, and alignment with engineering culture.

  6. Offer. Receiving the offer and details about the next steps.

Job Title: DevOps Engineer

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Client Business Hours (with flexibility for deployments, incident response, and on-call rotations)

About the Role

Our client is seeking a DevOps Engineer to build, maintain, and optimize scalable infrastructure and deployment pipelines that support fast, secure, and reliable software delivery.

This role requires strong expertise in cloud infrastructure, CI/CD automation, Kubernetes, monitoring, and infrastructure-as-code. The DevOps Engineer will work closely with development and engineering teams to improve deployment reliability, automate operational workflows, strengthen security, and ensure high system availability across environments.

This is an ideal role for someone who enjoys solving infrastructure challenges, optimizing systems at scale, and building highly automated and resilient environments.

Responsibilities

Infrastructure Management

  • Provision, configure, and maintain infrastructure across AWS, GCP, or Azure
    • Implement Infrastructure-as-Code using Terraform, Pulumi, or CloudFormation
    • Configure networking, compute, storage, IAM, and cloud services to support scalability and security
    • Optimize infrastructure performance, availability, and cost efficiency

CI/CD & Deployment Automation

  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or CircleCI
    • Automate build, test, deployment, and rollback workflows across environments
    • Improve deployment reliability and support zero-downtime deployment strategies
    • Partner with engineering teams to streamline release cycles and reduce bottlenecks

Containerization & Kubernetes

  • Manage Docker-based application environments and Kubernetes clusters
    • Deploy and maintain microservices-based architectures
    • Monitor cluster health, autoscaling, and workload performance
    • Improve container orchestration efficiency and infrastructure stability

Monitoring, Logging & Incident Response

  • Implement observability solutions using Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, New Relic, or similar tools
    • Configure centralized logging and alerting systems (ELK Stack, Splunk, CloudWatch, etc.)
    • Participate in incident response and on-call rotations when required
    • Conduct root cause analysis (RCA) and improve system resiliency post-incident

Security & Compliance

  • Apply cloud security best practices including IAM, least privilege access, and encryption standards
    • Support compliance initiatives related to SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, GDPR, or similar frameworks
    • Run vulnerability scans, patch systems proactively, and monitor infrastructure security posture
    • Ensure deployment pipelines and infrastructure configurations follow security standards

Documentation & Process Improvement

  • Maintain clear documentation for infrastructure, pipelines, runbooks, and deployment workflows
    • Identify opportunities for automation, reliability improvements, and operational efficiency
    • Collaborate cross-functionally with developers, QA, and engineering leadership to improve DevOps processes

What Makes You a Perfect Fit

  • Problem solver who thrives at the intersection of development and operations
    • Calm, methodical, and reliable during high-pressure incidents and outages
    • Passionate about automation, scalability, reliability, and system optimization
    • Strong communicator who collaborates effectively across technical and non-technical teams
    • Ownership-driven with a proactive approach to preventing issues before they occur

Required Experience & Skills

  • 3+ years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or Infrastructure Engineering
    • Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
    • Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation
    • Experience with Docker and Kubernetes in production environments
    • Familiarity with Linux systems administration and scripting
    • Experience with monitoring and logging platforms

Preferred Experience & Skills

  • Expertise with Terraform, Pulumi, or other Infrastructure-as-Code tools
    • Experience supporting SaaS, fintech, healthcare, or enterprise-scale applications
    • Familiarity with serverless architectures (AWS Lambda, Google Cloud Functions, Azure Functions)
    • Experience optimizing infrastructure costs and cloud resource utilization
    • Cloud or DevOps certifications such as AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, CKA, CKAD, or equivalent

What Does a Typical Day Look Like?

A DevOps Engineer’s day revolves around ensuring systems are automated, secure, scalable, and reliable. You will:

  • Review monitoring dashboards and investigate infrastructure alerts or incidents
    • Improve CI/CD pipelines to accelerate deployments and reduce failures
    • Provision or modify infrastructure using Terraform or CloudFormation
    • Collaborate with developers to troubleshoot deployments and optimize application performance
    • Analyze logs and system metrics to identify reliability or scalability issues
    • Update runbooks, workflows, and infrastructure documentation
    • Implement automation improvements that reduce manual operational work

In essence: you are the backbone of infrastructure reliability and deployment automation, ensuring systems remain stable, scalable, and efficient while enabling engineering teams to ship faster with confidence.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Deployment frequency and release reliability improvements

• System uptime ≥ 99.9%

  • Reduced MTTR (Mean Time to Recovery) for production incidents
    • Infrastructure cost optimization and efficiency improvements
    • Reduced deployment failures and rollback rates
    • Positive engineering feedback regarding deployment speed and reliability

Interview Process

  • Initial Phone Screen

• Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter

  • Technical Assessment (e.g., design a CI/CD pipeline or provision infrastructure using Terraform)
    • Client Interview with Engineering / DevOps Leadership

• Offer & Background Verification

Check out this Loom video for more details!

We’re looking for highly experienced software engineer (SR+) to help evaluate the quality of interactions with modern coding agents such as OpenAI Codex and Claude Code.

This is not a traditional engineering role.

You won’t be writing production code.

You’ll be evaluating something harder: whether the model thinks like a great engineer.

What This Role Actually Is

You will assess how AI coding agents behave in real-world scenarios — focusing on:

  • Whether the response makes sense

  • Whether the preamble and reasoning are useful

  • Whether the output reflects strong engineering judgment

  • Whether the interaction feels right to an experienced developer

This role is about engineering taste — not syntax correctness.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Evaluate AI-generated coding interactions end-to-end

  • Judge whether outputs are:

    • Useful

    • Correct (at a high level)

    • Aligned with how a strong engineer would think

  • Assess the quality of explanations and reasoning, not just code

  • Distinguish between different levels of response quality (e.g. what makes something a 2 vs 4)

  • Provide clear, opinionated feedback on:

    • What worked

    • What didn’t

    • What felt “off” or misleading

  • Help define what great looks like when interacting with tools like Cursor

What We Mean by “Taste”

We’re specifically looking for engineers who can answer questions like:

  • Does this feel like something a strong engineer would actually say?

  • Is this explanation helpful, or just technically correct?

  • Is the model guiding the user well, or just dumping output?

  • Would this interaction build or erode trust?

You should be comfortable making subjective but rigorous judgments.

Who You Are

    • Python

  • Hands-on experience using:

    • OpenAI Codex

    • Claude Code

  • Deep familiarity with modern AI-assisted dev workflows

  • Able to evaluate code without needing to fully execute or deeply review every line

  • Comfortable giving direct, opinionated feedback

  • High bar for what “good engineering” looks like

  • Process:

jobs.description:
Senior AI Interaction Evaluator (Codex / Claude Code)

Contract | $100–$200/hour | 10–20 hrs/week | Start ASAP (through early May)

Check out this Loom video for more details!

We’re looking for highly experienced software engineer (SR+) to help evaluate the quality of interactions with modern coding agents such as OpenAI Codex and Claude Code.

This is not a traditional engineering role.

You won’t be writing production code.

You’ll be evaluating something harder: whether the model thinks like a great engineer.

What This Role Actually Is

You will assess how AI coding agents behave in real-world scenarios — focusing on:

  • Whether the response makes sense

  • Whether the preamble and reasoning are useful

  • Whether the output reflects strong engineering judgment

  • Whether the interaction feels right to an experienced developer

This role is about engineering taste — not syntax correctness.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Evaluate AI-generated coding interactions end-to-end

  • Judge whether outputs are:

    • Useful

    • Correct (at a high level)

    • Aligned with how a strong engineer would think

  • Assess the quality of explanations and reasoning, not just code

  • Distinguish between different levels of response quality (e.g. what makes something a 2 vs 4)

  • Provide clear, opinionated feedback on:

    • What worked

    • What didn’t

    • What felt “off” or misleading

  • Help define what great looks like when interacting with tools like Cursor

What We Mean by “Taste”

We’re specifically looking for engineers who can answer questions like:

  • Does this feel like something a strong engineer would actually say?

  • Is this explanation helpful, or just technically correct?

  • Is the model guiding the user well, or just dumping output?

  • Would this interaction build or erode trust?

You should be comfortable making subjective but rigorous judgments.

Who You Are

  • Staff / Principal-level engineer (or equivalent experience)

  • Strong background in one of the below:

    • TypeScript / JavaScript

    • Python

  • Hands-on experience using:

    • OpenAI Codex

    • Claude Code

    • Cursor

  • Deep familiarity with modern AI-assisted dev workflows

  • Able to evaluate code without needing to fully execute or deeply review every line

  • Comfortable giving direct, opinionated feedback

  • High bar for what “good engineering” looks like

Nice to Have

  • Experience with tools like Cursor or similar AI-first IDEs

  • Prior exposure to prompt design or evaluation workflows

  • Experience mentoring senior engineers or defining engineering standards

Engagement Details

  • Rate: $100–$200/hour

  • Hours: ~10–20 hours/week

  • Duration: Through early May (with possible extension)

  • Start: ASAP

  • Process:

    • Take-home evaluation exercise

    • One behavioral interview
